sentences.zh: 天子納后儀

translations.literal: Rites for the Son of Heaven's Reception of an Empress
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Wedding Rites for Installing the Empress

sentences.zh: 凡納采問名，前期擇日，遣官告天地宗廟。

translations.literal: Generally, for betrothal gifts and inquiry of the name, on an appointed day beforehand officials were dispatched to announce the matter to Heaven, Earth, and the ancestral temples.
translations.idiomatic: For the betrothal and name-inquiry stages, a date was chosen in advance and officials were sent to report the ceremony to Heaven, Earth, and the ancestral temples.

sentences.zh: 至期，設御座、制案、節案、鹵簿、彩輿、中和大樂如儀。

translations.literal: When the day arrived, the imperial throne, tables for the commission and credential staff, ceremonial guard of honor, ceremonial carriage, and Grand Harmony music were set up according to ritual.
translations.idiomatic: On the appointed day, the throne, commission and tally tables, guard of honor, ceremonial carriage, and Grand Harmony ensemble were arranged as prescribed.

sentences.zh: 禮部陳禮物于丹陛上及文樓下。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Rites displayed the ceremonial gifts on the vermillion steps and below the Literary Tower.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Rites laid out the ceremonial gifts on the vermillion steps and at the foot of the Literary Tower.

sentences.zh: 質明，皇帝冕服升座，百官朝服行禮訖，各就位。

translations.literal: At dawn, the emperor in full ceremonial robes ascended the throne; the officials in court dress performed their obeisances, and each took his assigned place.
translations.idiomatic: At first light the emperor, in full court regalia, took the throne; the officials in audience dress completed their obeisances and returned to their stations.

sentences.zh: 正副使朝服四拜，執事舉制案、節案，由中門出，禮物隨之，俱置丹陛中道。

translations.literal: The chief and deputy envoys in court dress performed four prostrations; attendants lifted the commission and tally tables, passed out through the central gate with the gifts following, and set them all in the center of the vermillion steps.
translations.idiomatic: The chief and deputy envoys, in court dress, made four prostrations; attendants carried the commission and tally tables out through the central gate, the gifts following, and placed everything along the center of the vermillion steps.

sentences.zh: 傳制官宣制曰：「茲選某官某女爲皇后，命卿等持節行納采問名禮。

translations.literal: The edict proclaimer announced the imperial command: "Such-and-such an official's daughter is now selected as empress; you are commanded to bear the credential staff and perform the rites of betrothal gifts and name inquiry."
translations.idiomatic: The edict proclaimer announced: "The daughter of such-and-such an official is chosen as empress. You are commanded to bear the tally and perform the betrothal and name-inquiry rites."

sentences.zh: 」正副使四拜，駕興。

translations.literal: " The chief and deputy envoys performed four prostrations, and the imperial carriage departed.
translations.idiomatic: " The chief and deputy envoys made four prostrations, and the emperor's procession withdrew.

sentences.zh: 舉制、節案由奉天門中門出。

translations.literal: The commission and tally tables were carried out through the central gate of the Gate of Reverent Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: The commission and tally tables were borne out through the central gate of the Gate of Reverent Heaven.

sentences.zh: 正副使取節及制書置彩輿中，儀仗大樂前導，出大明門。

translations.literal: The chief and deputy envoys took the tally and commission documents, placed them in the ceremonial carriage, and with guard of honor and great music leading the way passed out through the Gate of Great Brilliance.
translations.idiomatic: The chief and deputy envoys placed the tally and commission documents in the ceremonial carriage; with guard of honor and ceremonial music leading, they passed out through the Gate of Great Brilliance.

sentences.zh: 釋朝服，乘馬行，詣皇后第。

translations.literal: They removed their court dress, mounted horses, and proceeded to the empress-elect's residence.
translations.idiomatic: They changed out of court dress, mounted, and rode to the empress-elect's residence.

sentences.zh: 第中設使者幕次於大門外左，南向，設香案於正堂，設制、節案於南，別設案於北。

translations.literal: At the residence a pavilion for the envoys was set to the left outside the main gate, facing south; an incense table was placed in the main hall; commission and tally tables were set to the south, with a separate table to the north.
translations.idiomatic: At the residence, an envoy pavilion was erected to the left of the outer gate, facing south; an incense table stood in the main hall; commission and tally tables were placed to the south and a separate table to the north.

sentences.zh: 使者至，引禮導入幕次，執事官陳禮物於正堂。

translations.literal: When the envoys arrived, ushers guided them into the pavilion, and officiating officials displayed the gifts in the main hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the envoys' arrival, ushers led them into the pavilion while officiants laid out the ceremonial gifts in the main hall.

sentences.zh: 使者出次，奉制書於案。

translations.literal: The envoys left the pavilion and placed the commission document upon the table.
translations.idiomatic: The envoys emerged from the pavilion and set the commission document on the table.

sentences.zh: 禮官先入，立於東；

translations.literal: Ritual officials entered first and stood to the east;
translations.idiomatic: Ritual officials entered first and took their places on the east side;

sentences.zh: 主婚朝服出，立於西。

translations.literal: the chief of the wedding party in court dress came forth and stood to the west.
translations.idiomatic: the bride's father, in court dress, came out and stood on the west side.

sentences.zh: 禮官曰：「奉制建后，遣使行納采問名禮。

translations.literal: The ritual official said: "By imperial command an empress is to be installed; envoys have been dispatched to perform the rites of betrothal gifts and name inquiry."
translations.idiomatic: The ritual official announced: "By imperial command an empress is to be installed; envoys have been sent to perform the betrothal and name-inquiry rites."

sentences.zh: 」引主婚者出迎。

translations.literal: " Ushers led the chief of the wedding party out to receive them.
translations.idiomatic: " The bride's father was led out to welcome them.

sentences.zh: 使者捧制書及節，主婚者隨至堂，置制書及節於案。

translations.literal: The envoys bore the commission document and tally; the chief of the wedding party followed them to the hall, and the commission and tally were placed upon the tables.
translations.idiomatic: The envoys carried the commission and tally; the bride's father followed them into the hall, where the documents were set on the tables.

sentences.zh: 正副使分立案左右。

translations.literal: The chief and deputy envoys took their places to the left and right of the tables.
translations.idiomatic: The chief and deputy envoys stood to either side of the tables.

sentences.zh: 主婚者四拜，詣案前跪。

translations.literal: The chief of the wedding party performed four prostrations, then went forward and knelt before the tables.
translations.idiomatic: The bride's father made four prostrations, then advanced and knelt before the tables.

sentences.zh: 正使取納采制，宣曰：「朕承天序，欽紹鴻圖。

translations.literal: The chief envoy took up the betrothal commission and proclaimed: "I have received Heaven's mandate and reverently continue the great design."
translations.idiomatic: The chief envoy took up the betrothal edict and proclaimed: "Having received Heaven's mandate, I reverently carry forward the great enterprise."

sentences.zh: 經國之道，正家爲本。

translations.literal: The way to govern the state takes ordering the family as its foundation.
translations.idiomatic: The art of governing the realm rests upon putting the household in order.

sentences.zh: 夫婦之倫，乾坤之義，實以相宗祀之敬，協奉養之誠，所資惟重。

translations.literal: The bond of husband and wife embodies the principle of Heaven and Earth; it truly supports reverence toward the ancestral temples and coordinates the sincerity of filial service—its importance is paramount.
translations.idiomatic: The relation of husband and wife embodies the cosmic order of Heaven and Earth; it sustains reverence for the ancestral temples and harmonizes the duty of filial service—nothing weighs more heavily upon it.

sentences.zh: 祗遵聖母皇太后命，遣使持節，以禮採擇。

translations.literal: Reverently following the command of the Sage Mother Empress Dowager, I dispatch envoys bearing the tally to select a consort according to ritual.
translations.idiomatic: In reverent obedience to the Empress Dowager's command, envoys bearing the tally are sent to make the ritual selection.

sentences.zh: 」宣訖，授主婚者。

translations.literal: " When the proclamation was finished, he handed it to the chief of the wedding party.
translations.idiomatic: " When the proclamation ended, he handed the document to the bride's father.

sentences.zh: 主婚者授執事者，置於北案上稍左。

translations.literal: The chief of the wedding party passed it to an attendant, who set it on the northern table slightly to the left.
translations.idiomatic: The bride's father passed it to an attendant, who placed it on the northern table, slightly to the left.

sentences.zh: 副使取問名制，宣曰：「朕惟夫婦之道，大倫之本。

translations.literal: The deputy envoy took up the name-inquiry commission and proclaimed: "I consider the way of husband and wife the foundation of the great human bonds."
translations.idiomatic: The deputy envoy took up the name-inquiry edict and proclaimed: "I regard the bond of husband and wife as the root of the great human relations."

sentences.zh: 正位乎內，必資名家。

translations.literal: To establish the proper place within the inner quarters requires a family of distinguished lineage.
translations.idiomatic: The inner household must be rightly ordered, and that requires a family of eminent standing.

sentences.zh: 特遣使持節以禮問名，尚佇來聞。

translations.literal: Envoys bearing the tally are specially dispatched to inquire the name according to ritual; I await your report.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys bearing the tally are specially sent to inquire the name by ritual; I await your reply.

sentences.zh: 」宣訖，授如前，置案上稍右。

translations.literal: " When the proclamation was finished, he handed it over as before, and it was placed on the table slightly to the right.
translations.idiomatic: " When the proclamation ended, he handed it over in the same manner, and it was set on the table slightly to the right.

sentences.zh: 主婚者俯伏，興。

translations.literal: The chief of the wedding party prostrated himself and then rose.
translations.idiomatic: The bride's father prostrated himself and rose.

sentences.zh: 執事舉表案，以表授主婚者。

translations.literal: An attendant lifted the memorial table and handed the memorial to the chief of the wedding party.
translations.idiomatic: An attendant brought forward the memorial table and handed the memorial to the bride's father.

sentences.zh: 主婚者跪授正使，表曰：「臣某，伏承嘉命。

translations.literal: The chief of the wedding party knelt and handed it to the chief envoy; the memorial read: "Your subject So-and-so humbly receives the gracious command."
translations.idiomatic: The bride's father knelt and presented it to the chief envoy; the memorial read: "Your subject So-and-so humbly receives the gracious command."

sentences.zh: 正使某官某等，重宣制詔，問臣名族。

translations.literal: The chief envoy, such-and-such an official, has again proclaimed the imperial edict and inquired after my clan and lineage.
translations.idiomatic: The chief envoy, such-and-such an official, has again proclaimed the imperial edict and inquired into my clan and lineage.

sentences.zh: 臣女，臣夫婦所生，先臣某官某之曾孫，先臣某官某之孫，先臣某官某之外孫。

translations.literal: My daughter, born to me and my wife, is the great-granddaughter of the former subject, such-and-such an official; the granddaughter of the former subject, such-and-such an official; and the granddaughter on the maternal side of the former subject, such-and-such an official.
translations.idiomatic: My daughter, born to my wife and me, is the great-granddaughter of the late official such-and-such, the granddaughter of the late official such-and-such, and the maternal granddaughter of the late official such-and-such.

sentences.zh: 臣女今年若干，謹具奏聞。

translations.literal: My daughter is this year of such-and-such an age; I respectfully submit this report for your hearing.
translations.idiomatic: My daughter is this year of such-and-such an age; I respectfully report this for your information.

sentences.zh: 」主婚者俯伏，興，退四拜。

translations.literal: " The chief of the wedding party prostrated himself, rose, withdrew, and performed four prostrations.
translations.idiomatic: " The bride's father prostrated himself, rose, withdrew, and made four prostrations.

sentences.zh: 使者出，置表彩輿中。

translations.literal: The envoys departed and placed the memorial in the ceremonial carriage.
translations.idiomatic: The envoys withdrew and placed the memorial in the ceremonial carriage.

sentences.zh: 主婚者前曰：「請禮從者。

translations.literal: The chief of the wedding party came forward and said: "Please extend ritual courtesy to the attendants."
translations.idiomatic: The bride's father stepped forward and said: "Please honor my attendants with ritual courtesy."

sentences.zh: 」酒饌畢，主婚者捧幣以勞使者。

translations.literal: " When the wine and food were finished, the chief of the wedding party bore silks to reward the envoys.
translations.idiomatic: " After the feast, the bride's father presented silks to reward the envoys.

sentences.zh: 使者出，主婚者送至大門外。

translations.literal: The envoys departed, and the chief of the wedding party escorted them to the outer gate.
translations.idiomatic: The envoys left, and the bride's father saw them to the outer gate.

sentences.zh: 使者隨彩輿入大明門左門，至奉天門外，以表節授司禮監，覆命。

translations.literal: The envoys followed the ceremonial carriage through the left gate of the Gate of Great Brilliance to the outside of the Gate of Reverent Heaven, handed the memorial and tally to the Directorate of Ceremonial, and reported back.
translations.idiomatic: The envoys followed the ceremonial carriage through the left gate of the Gate of Great Brilliance to the Gate of Reverent Heaven, delivered the memorial and tally to the Directorate of Ceremonial, and reported their mission complete.

sentences.zh: 次納吉、納徵、告期，傳制遣使，並如前儀。

translations.literal: Next, for the auspicious confirmation, betrothal gifts, and announcement of the wedding date, an edict was issued and envoys dispatched—all following the previous ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Next came the auspicious confirmation, betrothal gifts, and announcement of the wedding date; an edict was issued and envoys sent, all following the same ritual as before.

sentences.zh: 但納徵用玄纁、束帛、六馬、穀圭等物，制詞曰：「茲聘某官某女爲皇后，命卿等持節行納吉、納徵、告期禮。

translations.literal: Only for the betrothal gifts were dark-red and light-red silks, bundled silks, six horses, grain jades, and the like used; the edict read: "Such-and-such an official's daughter is now betrothed as empress; you are commanded to bear the tally and perform the rites of auspicious confirmation, betrothal gifts, and announcement of the date."
translations.idiomatic: For the betrothal gifts alone, dark-red and light-red silks, bundled silks, six horses, grain jades, and the like were used; the edict read: "The daughter of such-and-such an official is betrothed as empress. You are commanded to bear the tally and perform the rites of auspicious confirmation, betrothal gifts, and date announcement."

sentences.zh: 」皇后第，陳設如前，惟更設玉帛案。

translations.literal: " At the empress-elect's residence the arrangements were as before, except that a table for jade and silks was added.
translations.idiomatic: " At the empress-elect's residence the arrangements were as before, with the addition of a table for jade and silks.

sentences.zh: 使者至，以制書、玉帛置案上，六馬陳堂下。

translations.literal: When the envoys arrived, they placed the commission documents and jade and silks upon the tables, and the six horses were arrayed below the hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the envoys' arrival, they set the commission documents and jade and silks on the tables, with the six horses arrayed below the hall.

sentences.zh: 執事先設皇后冠服諸物於正堂。

translations.literal: Attendants had beforehand set out in the main hall the empress's crown, robes, and other items.
translations.idiomatic: Attendants had already laid out in the main hall the empress's crown, robes, and related items.

sentences.zh: 禮官入，主婚者出迎，執事舉玉帛案，正使捧納吉、納徵制書，副使捧告期制書，執節者捧節，以次入，各置於案。

translations.literal: Ritual officials entered; the chief of the wedding party came out to receive them; attendants lifted the jade-and-silk table; the chief envoy bore the commissions for auspicious confirmation and betrothal gifts; the deputy envoy bore the commission for announcing the date; the tally bearer bore the tally; they entered in order and set each item upon its table.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual officials entered; the bride's father came out to welcome them; attendants brought forward the jade-and-silk table; the chief envoy carried the edicts for auspicious confirmation and betrothal gifts; the deputy envoy carried the date-announcement edict; the tally bearer carried the tally; they entered in succession and placed each item on its table.

sentences.zh: 主婚者四拜，詣案前跪。

translations.literal: The chief of the wedding party performed four prostrations and knelt before the tables.
translations.idiomatic: The bride's father made four prostrations and knelt before the tables.

sentences.zh: 正使取制書，宣曰：「大婚之卜，龜筮師士協從。

translations.literal: The chief envoy took up the commission and proclaimed: "The divination for the great wedding—tortoise, milfoil, masters, and officers all agreed."
translations.idiomatic: The chief envoy took up the edict and proclaimed: "The divination for the great wedding has been performed; tortoise, milfoil, masters, and officers all concurred."

sentences.zh: 敬循禮典，遣使持節告吉。

translations.literal: Reverently following the ritual canon, envoys bearing the tally are dispatched to announce the auspicious result.
translations.idiomatic: In reverent accordance with the ritual canon, envoys bearing the tally are sent to announce the auspicious outcome.

sentences.zh: 」又宣曰：「卿女有貞靜之德，稱母儀之選，宜共承天地宗廟。

translations.literal: " He further proclaimed: "Your daughter possesses the virtue of steadfast purity and is fit to be chosen as a model of motherhood; she is suited to share in honoring Heaven, Earth, and the ancestral temples."
translations.idiomatic: " He further proclaimed: "Your daughter possesses steadfast and tranquil virtue and is worthy to be chosen as a model of motherhood; she is fit to share in honoring Heaven, Earth, and the ancestral temples."

sentences.zh: 特遣使持節，以禮納徵。

translations.literal: Envoys bearing the tally are specially dispatched to present the betrothal gifts according to ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys bearing the tally are specially sent to present the betrothal gifts by ritual.

sentences.zh: 」宣訖，授主婚者。

translations.literal: " When the proclamation was finished, he handed it to the chief of the wedding party.
translations.idiomatic: " When the proclamation ended, he handed it to the bride's father.

sentences.zh: 正副使又捧圭及玄纁以授主婚者，俱如前儀。

translations.literal: The chief and deputy envoys again bore the jade tablet and dark-red and light-red silks and presented them to the chief of the wedding party, all as in the previous ritual.
translations.idiomatic: The chief and deputy envoys again presented the jade tablet and dark-red and light-red silks to the bride's father, all as before.

sentences.zh: 副使取制書，宣曰：「歲令月良，吉日某甲子，大婚維宜。

translations.literal: The deputy envoy took up the commission and proclaimed: "The season is right, the month auspicious; on the propitious day of such-and-such a cyclical date the great wedding is most fitting."
translations.idiomatic: The deputy envoy took up the edict and proclaimed: "The season is favorable and the month auspicious; on the propitious day of such-and-such a cyclical date the great wedding is most fitting."

sentences.zh: 特遣使持節，以禮告期。

translations.literal: Envoys bearing the tally are specially dispatched to announce the date according to ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys bearing the tally are specially sent to announce the wedding date by ritual.

sentences.zh: 」宣訖，授如前儀。

translations.literal: " When the proclamation was finished, he handed it over as in the previous ritual.
translations.idiomatic: " When the proclamation ended, he handed it over as before.

sentences.zh: 主婚者四拜，使者持節出，主婚者禮使者，使者還，覆命如初。

translations.literal: The chief of the wedding party performed four prostrations; the envoys bore the tally and departed; the chief of the wedding party rewarded the envoys; the envoys returned and reported back as at first.
translations.idiomatic: The bride's father made four prostrations; the envoys bore the tally and withdrew; the bride's father rewarded the envoys; they returned and reported their mission complete, as before.

sentences.zh: 次發冊奉迎，所司陳設如前儀。

translations.literal: Next came the issuance of the investiture document and the welcoming escort; the responsible offices set out the arrangements as in the previous ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Next came the issuance of the investiture and the welcoming escort; the responsible offices made the arrangements as before.

sentences.zh: 禮部陳雁及禮物于丹陛上，內官監陳皇后鹵簿車輅於奉天門外。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Rites displayed the wild geese and ceremonial gifts on the vermillion steps; the Directorate of Palace Attendants arrayed the empress's guard of honor and carriage outside the Gate of Reverent Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Rites laid out the wild geese and ceremonial gifts on the vermillion steps; the Directorate of Palace Attendants arrayed the empress's guard of honor and carriage outside the Gate of Reverent Heaven.

sentences.zh: 制詞曰：「茲冊某官某女爲皇后，命卿等持節奉冊寶，行奉迎禮。

translations.literal: The edict read: "Such-and-such an official's daughter is now invested as empress; you are commanded to bear the tally, present the investiture document and imperial seal, and perform the welcoming escort rite."
translations.idiomatic: The edict read: "The daughter of such-and-such an official is invested as empress. You are commanded to bear the tally, present the investiture and imperial seal, and perform the welcoming escort rite."

sentences.zh: 」正副使以冊寶置彩輿中，隨詣皇后第。

translations.literal: " The chief and deputy envoys placed the investiture document and seal in the ceremonial carriage and proceeded to the empress-elect's residence.
translations.idiomatic: " The chief and deputy envoys placed the investiture and seal in the ceremonial carriage and proceeded to the empress-elect's residence.

sentences.zh: 至門，取制書冊寶置案上。

translations.literal: At the gate they took out the commission, investiture document, and seal and set them upon the tables.
translations.idiomatic: At the gate they removed the commission, investiture, and seal and set them on the tables.

sentences.zh: 禮官先入，主婚者朝服出見。

translations.literal: Ritual officials entered first; the chief of the wedding party in court dress came out to receive them.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual officials entered first; the bride's father, in court dress, came out to receive them.

sentences.zh: 禮官曰：「奉制冊后，遣使持節奉冊寶，行奉迎禮。

translations.literal: The ritual official said: "By imperial command an empress is invested; envoys bearing the tally present the investiture document and seal to perform the welcoming escort rite."
translations.idiomatic: The ritual official announced: "By imperial command an empress is invested; envoys bearing the tally present the investiture and seal to perform the welcoming escort rite."

sentences.zh: 」主婚者出迎。

translations.literal: " The chief of the wedding party came out to receive them.
translations.idiomatic: " The bride's father came out to welcome them.

sentences.zh: 執事者舉案前行，使者捧制書及節，執事者以雁及禮物從之。

translations.literal: Attendants lifted the tables and went forward; the envoys bore the commission and tally; attendants followed with the wild geese and ceremonial gifts.
translations.idiomatic: Attendants carried the tables forward; the envoys bore the commission and tally; attendants followed with the wild geese and ceremonial gifts.

sentences.zh: 至堂中，各置於案。

translations.literal: Upon reaching the hall, each item was set upon its table.
translations.idiomatic: In the hall, each item was placed on its table.

sentences.zh: 使者左右立，主婚者四拜，退立於西南。

translations.literal: The envoys stood to the left and right; the chief of the wedding party performed four prostrations, withdrew, and stood to the southwest.
translations.idiomatic: The envoys stood to either side; the bride's father made four prostrations, withdrew, and took his place to the southwest.

sentences.zh: 女官以九龍四鳳冠禕衣進皇后。

translations.literal: Female officials presented to the empress-elect the nine-dragon four-phoenix crown and ceremonial robes.
translations.idiomatic: Female officials brought the empress-elect her nine-dragon four-phoenix crown and ceremonial robes.

sentences.zh: 內官陳儀仗於中堂前，設女樂於堂下，作止如常儀。

translations.literal: Inner palace officials arrayed the guard of honor before the central hall and set female musicians below the hall; music began and ceased according to the usual ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Inner palace officials arrayed the guard of honor before the central hall and stationed female musicians below; music began and ceased according to the usual ritual.

sentences.zh: 使者以節冊寶授司禮監官，內贊導入中堂。

translations.literal: The envoys handed the tally, investiture document, and seal to an official of the Directorate of Ceremonial, and inner announcers guided them into the central hall.
translations.idiomatic: The envoys handed the tally, investiture, and seal to an official of the Directorate of Ceremonial; inner announcers led the procession into the central hall.

sentences.zh: 皇后具服出閣，詣香案前，向闕立，四拜。

translations.literal: The empress-elect, fully robed, emerged from her chamber, went before the incense table, faced the imperial palace, stood, and performed four prostrations.
translations.idiomatic: The empress-elect, fully attired, emerged from her chamber, advanced to the incense table, faced the imperial palace, and made four prostrations.

sentences.zh: 贊宣冊，皇后跪。

translations.literal: The announcer proclaimed the investiture; the empress-elect knelt.
translations.idiomatic: The announcer proclaimed the investiture; the empress-elect knelt.

sentences.zh: 宣冊官宣訖，以授皇后。

translations.literal: When the investiture proclaimer had finished, he handed it to the empress-elect.
translations.idiomatic: When the investiture proclaimer had finished, he handed the document to the empress-elect.

sentences.zh: 皇后搢圭，受冊，以授女官。

translations.literal: The empress-elect inserted the jade tablet, received the investiture document, and handed it to a female official.
translations.idiomatic: The empress-elect inserted the jade tablet, received the investiture, and handed it to a female official.

sentences.zh: 女官跪受，立於西。

translations.literal: The female official knelt to receive it and stood to the west.
translations.idiomatic: The female official knelt to receive it and stood on the west side.

sentences.zh: 贊宣寶，如宣冊儀。

translations.literal: The announcer proclaimed the seal, following the same ritual as for proclaiming the investiture.
translations.idiomatic: The announcer proclaimed the seal, following the same ritual as for the investiture.

sentences.zh: 贊出圭，贊興，四拜訖，皇后入閣。

translations.literal: The announcer called for the removal of the jade tablet and for her to rise; when the four prostrations were complete, the empress-elect returned to her chamber.
translations.idiomatic: The announcer called for the jade tablet to be removed and for her to rise; when the four prostrations were finished, the empress-elect withdrew to her chamber.

sentences.zh: 司禮監官持節出，授使者，報受冊寶禮畢。

translations.literal: An official of the Directorate of Ceremonial bore the tally out, handed it to the envoys, and reported that the rite of receiving the investiture and seal was complete.
translations.idiomatic: An official of the Directorate of Ceremonial bore the tally out, handed it to the envoys, and reported that the rite of receiving the investiture and seal was complete.

sentences.zh: 主婚者詣案前跪。

translations.literal: The chief of the wedding party went forward and knelt before the tables.
translations.idiomatic: The bride's father advanced and knelt before the tables.

sentences.zh: 正使取奉迎制宣訖，授主婚者。

translations.literal: The chief envoy took up the welcoming escort commission, finished the proclamation, and handed it to the chief of the wedding party.
translations.idiomatic: The chief envoy took up the welcoming escort edict, finished the proclamation, and handed it to the bride's father.

sentences.zh: 副使進雁及禮物。

translations.literal: The deputy envoy presented the wild geese and ceremonial gifts.
translations.idiomatic: The deputy envoy presented the wild geese and ceremonial gifts.

sentences.zh: 主婚者皆跪受，如前儀。

translations.literal: The chief of the wedding party knelt to receive them all, as in the previous ritual.
translations.idiomatic: The bride's father knelt to receive them all, as before.

sentences.zh: 主婚者興，使者四拜出。

translations.literal: The chief of the wedding party rose; the envoys performed four prostrations and departed.
translations.idiomatic: The bride's father rose; the envoys made four prostrations and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 主婚者禮使者如初。

translations.literal: The chief of the wedding party rewarded the envoys as at first.
translations.idiomatic: The bride's father rewarded the envoys as before.

sentences.zh: 女官奏請皇后出閣。

translations.literal: A female official memorialized requesting the empress-elect to emerge from her chamber.
translations.idiomatic: A female official announced that the empress-elect was requested to emerge from her chamber.

sentences.zh: 自東階下，立香案前，四拜。

translations.literal: She descended by the eastern steps, stood before the incense table, and performed four prostrations.
translations.idiomatic: She descended the eastern steps, stood before the incense table, and made four prostrations.

sentences.zh: 升堂，南向立。

translations.literal: She ascended the hall and stood facing south.
translations.idiomatic: She ascended the hall and stood facing south.

sentences.zh: 主婚者進立於東，西向，曰：「戒之敬之，夙夜無違。

translations.literal: The chief of the wedding party advanced and stood to the east, facing west, and said: "Be warned and be reverent; morning and night do not transgress."
translations.idiomatic: The bride's father advanced and stood on the east side, facing west, and said: "Be warned and be reverent; morning and night, do not stray."

sentences.zh: 」退立於東階。

translations.literal: " He withdrew and stood on the eastern steps.
translations.idiomatic: " He withdrew and took his place on the eastern steps.

sentences.zh: 母進，立於西，東向，施衿結帨，曰：「勉之敬之，夙夜無違。

translations.literal: The mother advanced, stood to the west facing east, adjusted the collar and tied the sash, and said: "Strive and be reverent; morning and night do not transgress."
translations.idiomatic: The mother advanced, stood on the west side facing east, adjusted the collar and tied the sash, and said: "Strive and be reverent; morning and night, do not stray."

sentences.zh: 」退立於西階。

translations.literal: " She withdrew and stood on the western steps.
translations.idiomatic: " She withdrew and took her place on the western steps.

sentences.zh: 內執事請乘輿，皇后降階升輿。

translations.literal: Inner attendants requested her to mount the carriage; the empress-elect descended the steps and entered the carriage.
translations.idiomatic: Inner attendants invited her to mount the carriage; the empress-elect descended the steps and entered it.

sentences.zh: 導從出，儀仗大樂前行，次彩輿，正副使隨，次司禮監官擁導，從大明門中門入。

translations.literal: The escort departed; guard of honor and great music led the way, then the ceremonial carriage, the chief and deputy envoys following, then officials of the Directorate of Ceremonial escorting; they entered through the central gate of the Gate of Great Brilliance.
translations.idiomatic: The procession set out; guard of honor and ceremonial music led, then the ceremonial carriage, with the chief and deputy envoys following and officials of the Directorate of Ceremonial escorting; they entered through the central gate of the Gate of Great Brilliance.

sentences.zh: 百官朝服於承天門外班迎，候輿入，乃退。

translations.literal: Officials in court dress lined up outside the Gate of Accepting Heaven to welcome her; when the carriage had entered, they withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Officials in court dress formed ranks outside the Gate of Accepting Heaven to welcome her; when the carriage had entered, they withdrew.

sentences.zh: 皇后至午門外，鳴鐘鼓，鹵簿止。

translations.literal: When the empress reached the outside of the Meridian Gate, bells and drums were sounded and the guard of honor halted.
translations.idiomatic: When the empress reached the outside of the Meridian Gate, bells and drums sounded and the guard of honor halted.

sentences.zh: 正副使以節授司禮監，覆命。

translations.literal: The chief and deputy envoys handed the tally to the Directorate of Ceremonial and reported back.
translations.idiomatic: The chief and deputy envoys handed the tally to the Directorate of Ceremonial and reported their mission complete.

sentences.zh: 捧冊寶官捧冊寶，儀仗女樂前導，進奉天門。

translations.literal: Officials bearing the investiture document and seal carried them forward; guard of honor and female musicians led the way into the Gate of Reverent Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Officials bearing the investiture and seal led the way, with guard of honor and female musicians preceding them into the Gate of Reverent Heaven.

sentences.zh: 至內庭幕次，司禮監以冊寶授女官。

translations.literal: Upon reaching the inner court pavilion, the Directorate of Ceremonial handed the investiture document and seal to female officials.
translations.idiomatic: At the inner court pavilion, the Directorate of Ceremonial handed the investiture and seal to female officials.

sentences.zh: 皇后出輿，由西階進。

translations.literal: The empress left the carriage and entered by the western steps.
translations.idiomatic: The empress descended from the carriage and entered by the western steps.

sentences.zh: 皇帝由東階降迎於庭，揖皇后入內殿。

translations.literal: The emperor descended the eastern steps to welcome her in the courtyard, bowed to her, and led her into the inner hall.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor descended the eastern steps to welcome her in the courtyard, bowed to her, and escorted her into the inner hall.

sentences.zh: 帝詣更服處，具袞冕。

translations.literal: The emperor went to the changing room and donned his dragon robes and crown.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor went to the robing chamber and donned his dragon robes and crown.

sentences.zh: 后詣更服處，更禮服。

translations.literal: The empress went to the changing room and changed into ceremonial dress.
translations.idiomatic: The empress went to the robing chamber and changed into ceremonial dress.

sentences.zh: 同詣奉先殿，行謁廟禮。

translations.literal: Together they proceeded to the Hall of Imperial Ancestors and performed the rite of paying respects at the temple.
translations.idiomatic: Together they proceeded to the Hall of Imperial Ancestors and performed the temple obeisance rite.

sentences.zh: 祭畢，還宮。

translations.literal: When the sacrifice was complete, they returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: When the sacrifice was finished, they returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 合巹，帝更皮弁，升內殿。

translations.literal: They joined the nuptial cups; the emperor changed into the leather cap and ascended the inner hall.
translations.idiomatic: They shared the nuptial cups; the emperor changed into the leather cap and ascended the inner hall.

sentences.zh: 后更衣，從升。

translations.literal: The empress changed her robes and followed him up.
translations.idiomatic: The empress changed her robes and followed him up.

sentences.zh: 各升座，東西相向。

translations.literal: Each ascended to a seat, facing one another east and west.
translations.idiomatic: Each took a seat, facing one another across the east-west axis.

sentences.zh: 執事者舉饌案於前，女官取四金爵，酌酒以進。

translations.literal: Attendants lifted the food table before them; female officials took four golden goblets, poured wine, and presented it.
translations.idiomatic: Attendants brought forward the food table; female officials took four golden goblets, poured wine, and presented it.

sentences.zh: 既飲，進饌。

translations.literal: After they had drunk, food was presented.
translations.idiomatic: After they had drunk, the meal was served.

sentences.zh: 復進酒、進飯訖，女官以兩巹酌酒，合和以進。

translations.literal: Wine and rice were again presented; when this was finished, female officials poured wine from two nuptial cups, mingled them, and presented the mixture.
translations.idiomatic: Wine and rice were served again; when this was finished, female officials poured wine from two nuptial cups, mingled them, and presented the mixture.

sentences.zh: 既飲，又進饌畢，興，易常服。

translations.literal: After they had drunk and the food was again finished, they rose and changed into ordinary dress.
translations.idiomatic: After they had drunk and the meal was finished, they rose and changed into ordinary dress.

sentences.zh: 帝從者餕后之饌，后從者餕帝之饌。

translations.literal: The emperor's attendants ate what remained of the empress's food; the empress's attendants ate what remained of the emperor's food.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's attendants ate the empress's leftover food; the empress's attendants ate the emperor's leftover food.

sentences.zh: 次日早，帝后皆禮服，候太后升座。

translations.literal: Early the next morning, emperor and empress both in ceremonial dress waited for the empress dowager to ascend her seat.
translations.idiomatic: Early the next morning, the emperor and empress, both in ceremonial dress, waited for the empress dowager to take her seat.

sentences.zh: 帝后進座前。

translations.literal: The emperor and empress advanced before her seat.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor and empress advanced before her seat.

sentences.zh: 宮人以腶修盤立於后左，帝后皆四拜。

translations.literal: Palace women stood to the empress's left holding a tray of cured meat; the emperor and empress each performed four prostrations.
translations.idiomatic: Palace women stood to the empress's left holding a tray of cured meat; the emperor and empress each made four prostrations.

sentences.zh: 執事舉案至，宮人以腶修盤授后，后捧置於案。

translations.literal: Attendants brought the table forward; a palace woman handed the cured-meat tray to the empress, who bore it and set it upon the table.
translations.idiomatic: Attendants brought the table forward; a palace woman handed the cured-meat tray to the empress, who placed it on the table.

sentences.zh: 女官舉案，后隨至太后前，進訖，復位。

translations.literal: Female officials lifted the table; the empress followed to the empress dowager, presented the offering, and returned to her place.
translations.idiomatic: Female officials carried the table; the empress followed to the empress dowager, presented the offering, and returned to her place.

sentences.zh: 帝后皆四拜。

translations.literal: The emperor and empress each performed four prostrations.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor and empress each made four prostrations.

sentences.zh: 三日早，帝冕服，后禮服，同詣太后宮，行八拜禮。

translations.literal: Early on the third day, the emperor in full ceremonial robes and the empress in ceremonial dress together proceeded to the empress dowager's palace and performed the eight-prostration rite.
translations.idiomatic: Early on the third day, the emperor in full court regalia and the empress in ceremonial dress together visited the empress dowager's palace and performed the eight-prostration rite.

sentences.zh: 還宮，帝服皮弁，升座。

translations.literal: They returned to the palace; the emperor donned the leather cap and ascended his seat.
translations.idiomatic: They returned to the palace; the emperor donned the leather cap and took his seat.

sentences.zh: 女宮導后，禮服詣帝前，行八拜禮。

translations.literal: Female palace officials guided the empress in ceremonial dress before the emperor, where she performed the eight-prostration rite.
translations.idiomatic: Female palace officials guided the empress, in ceremonial dress, before the emperor, where she performed the eight-prostration rite.

sentences.zh: 后還宮，升座。

translations.literal: The empress returned to her palace and ascended her seat.
translations.idiomatic: The empress returned to her palace and took her seat.

sentences.zh: 引禮導在內親屬及六尚等女官，行八拜禮；

translations.literal: Ushers guided the inner kin and female officials such as the Six Chiefs, who performed the eight-prostration rite;
translations.idiomatic: Ushers led the inner kin and female officials such as the Six Chiefs, who performed the eight-prostration rite;

sentences.zh: 次各監局內官內使，行八拜禮。

translations.literal: next the inner eunuchs and attendants of each directorate performed the eight-prostration rite.
translations.idiomatic: next the inner eunuchs and attendants of each directorate performed the eight-prostration rite.

sentences.zh: 是日，皇帝御奉天殿。

translations.literal: On that day the emperor presided in the Hall of Reverent Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: That day the emperor presided in the Hall of Reverent Heaven.

sentences.zh: 頒詔如常儀。

translations.literal: An edict was promulgated according to the usual ritual.
translations.idiomatic: An edict was promulgated according to the usual ritual.

sentences.zh: 四日早，皇帝服袞冕御華蓋殿，親王八拜，次執事官五拜，遂升奉天殿，百官進表，行慶賀禮。

translations.literal: Early on the fourth day, the emperor in dragon robes and crown presided in the Hall of Flowering Canopy; imperial princes performed eight prostrations, then officiating officials five prostrations; he then ascended the Hall of Reverent Heaven, officials submitted memorials, and the congratulatory rite was performed.
translations.idiomatic: Early on the fourth day, the emperor in dragon robes and crown presided in the Hall of Flowering Canopy; imperial princes made eight prostrations, then officiating officials five; he then ascended the Hall of Reverent Heaven, where officials submitted memorials and the congratulatory rite was performed.

sentences.zh: 是日，太后及皇后各禮服升座。

translations.literal: On that day the empress dowager and empress each in ceremonial dress ascended their seats.
translations.idiomatic: That day the empress dowager and empress, each in ceremonial dress, took their seats.

sentences.zh: 親王入，八拜出，次內外命婦慶賀及外命婦進表箋，皆如常儀。

translations.literal: Imperial princes entered, performed eight prostrations, and withdrew; next inner and outer titled ladies offered congratulations, and outer titled ladies submitted memorials and letters—all according to the usual ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial princes entered, made eight prostrations, and withdrew; next inner and outer titled ladies offered congratulations, and outer titled ladies submitted memorials and letters—all according to the usual ritual.

sentences.zh: 五日行盥饋禮，尚膳監具膳修。

translations.literal: On the fifth day the hand-washing and food-offering rite was performed; the Directorate of Imperial Viands prepared the dishes.
translations.idiomatic: On the fifth day the hand-washing and food-offering rite was performed; the Directorate of Imperial Viands prepared the dishes.

sentences.zh: 皇后禮服詣太后前，四拜。

translations.literal: The empress in ceremonial dress went before the empress dowager and performed four prostrations.
translations.idiomatic: The empress, in ceremonial dress, went before the empress dowager and made four prostrations.

sentences.zh: 尚食以膳授皇后，皇后捧膳進於案，復位，四拜，退立於西南。

translations.literal: The Chief of Food Service handed the dishes to the empress; the empress bore them forward and set them on the table, returned to her place, performed four prostrations, and withdrew to stand in the southwest.
translations.idiomatic: The Chief of Food Service handed the dishes to the empress; she bore them forward and set them on the table, returned to her place, made four prostrations, and withdrew to stand in the southwest.

sentences.zh: 俟膳畢，引出。

translations.literal: When the meal was finished, she was led out.
translations.idiomatic: When the meal was finished, she was led out.

sentences.zh: 皇太子納妃儀

translations.literal: Rites for the Crown Prince's Reception of a Consort
translations.idiomatic: Crown Prince Wedding Rites

sentences.zh: 納采、問名。

translations.literal: Betrothal gifts and name inquiry.
translations.idiomatic: Betrothal and name inquiry.

sentences.zh: 制曰：「奉制納某氏女爲皇太子妃，命卿等行納采問名禮。

translations.literal: The edict read: "By imperial command the daughter of such-and-such a clan is received as crown princess; you are commanded to perform the rites of betrothal gifts and name inquiry."
translations.idiomatic: The edict read: "By imperial command the daughter of such-and-such a clan is received as crown princess. You are commanded to perform the betrothal and name-inquiry rites."

sentences.zh: 」至妃第，儐者出，詣使者前曰：「敢請事。

translations.literal: " Upon reaching the princess-elect's residence, the usher came out, went before the envoy, and said: "I venture to ask your business."
translations.idiomatic: " At the crown princess-elect's residence, the usher came out, approached the envoy, and said: "May I ask your business?"

sentences.zh: 」使者曰：「儲宮納配，屬於令德。

translations.literal: " The envoy said: "The heir apparent's consort must possess outstanding virtue."
translations.idiomatic: " The envoy said: "The heir apparent's consort must be a woman of outstanding virtue."

sentences.zh: 邦有常典，使某行納采之禮。

translations.literal: The state has its established canon; I am sent to perform the rite of betrothal gifts.
translations.idiomatic: The state has its established canon; I am sent to perform the betrothal rite.

sentences.zh: 」儐者入告，主婚者曰：「臣某之子，昧於壼儀，不足以備採擇。

translations.literal: " The usher went in to report; the chief of the wedding party said: "My daughter is ignorant of inner-chamber propriety and is not fit to be chosen."
translations.idiomatic: " The usher went in to report; the bride's father said: "My daughter is unversed in inner-chamber propriety and is unworthy to be chosen."

sentences.zh: 恭承製命，臣某不敢辭。

translations.literal: Reverently receiving the imperial command, your subject So-and-so dares not decline.
translations.idiomatic: Reverently receiving the imperial command, your subject So-and-so dares not decline.

sentences.zh: 」儐者出告，使者入，陳禮物於庭，宣制曰：「某奉詔採擇。

translations.literal: " The usher came out to report; the envoy entered, displayed the gifts in the courtyard, and proclaimed the edict: "I, So-and-so, bear the imperial command to make the selection."
translations.idiomatic: " The usher came out to report; the envoy entered, displayed the gifts in the courtyard, and proclaimed: "I, So-and-so, bear the imperial command to make the selection."

sentences.zh: 」奠雁禮畢，使者出。

translations.literal: " When the rite of presenting the wild geese was complete, the envoy departed.
translations.idiomatic: " When the wild-goose presentation rite was finished, the envoy withdrew.

sentences.zh: 儐者復詣使者前曰：「敢請事。

translations.literal: The usher again went before the envoy and said: "I venture to ask your business."
translations.idiomatic: The usher again approached the envoy and said: "May I ask your business?"

sentences.zh: 」使者曰：「儲宮之配，採擇既諧。

translations.literal: " The envoy said: "The selection for the heir apparent's consort is now settled."
translations.idiomatic: " The envoy said: "The selection for the heir apparent's consort is now settled."

sentences.zh: 將加卜筮，奉制問名。

translations.literal: Divination by tortoise and milfoil is next to be performed; by imperial command I inquire the name.
translations.idiomatic: Divination is next to be performed; by imperial command I inquire the name.

sentences.zh: 」儐者入告，主婚者曰：「制以臣某之女，可以奉侍儲宮，臣某不敢辭。

translations.literal: " The usher went in to report; the chief of the wedding party said: "The command designates my daughter as fit to serve the heir apparent; your subject So-and-so dares not decline."
translations.idiomatic: " The usher went in to report; the bride's father said: "The command designates my daughter as fit to serve the heir apparent; your subject So-and-so dares not decline."

sentences.zh: 儐者出告。

translations.literal: The usher came out to report.
translations.idiomatic: The usher came out to report.

sentences.zh: 使者復入，陳禮奠雁如儀，宣制曰：「臣某奉詔問名，將謀諸卜筮。

translations.literal: The envoy entered again, displayed the gifts and presented the wild geese as in ritual, and proclaimed: "Your subject So-and-so, bearing the imperial command to inquire the name, will consult divination."
translations.idiomatic: The envoy entered again, displayed the gifts and presented the wild geese as prescribed, and proclaimed: "Your subject So-and-so, bearing the imperial command to inquire the name, will consult divination."

sentences.zh: 」主婚者曰：「臣某第幾女，某氏出。」

translations.literal: " The chief of the wedding party said: "Your subject's such-and-such-numbered daughter, born of the such-and-such clan."
translations.idiomatic: " The bride's father said: "Your subject's such-and-such-numbered daughter, born of the such-and-such clan."

sentences.zh: 次納吉。

translations.literal: Next came the auspicious confirmation.
translations.idiomatic: Next came the auspicious confirmation.

sentences.zh: 儐者請事如前，使者曰：「謀諸卜筮，其佔協從，制使某告吉。

translations.literal: The usher asked his business as before; the envoy said: "Having consulted divination, the omens are favorable; by imperial command I, So-and-so, announce the auspicious result."
translations.idiomatic: The usher asked his business as before; the envoy said: "Having consulted divination, the omens are favorable; by imperial command I, So-and-so, announce the auspicious outcome."

sentences.zh: 」儐者入告，主婚者曰：「臣某之子蠢愚，懼弗克堪。

translations.literal: " The usher went in to report; the chief of the wedding party said: "My daughter is foolish and dull; I fear she will not measure up."
translations.idiomatic: " The usher went in to report; the bride's father said: "My daughter is foolish and dull; I fear she will not measure up."

sentences.zh: 卜筮云吉，惟臣之幸，臣謹奉典制。

translations.literal: The divination declares it auspicious—this is my good fortune alone; your subject reverently follows the canonical ritual.
translations.idiomatic: The divination declares it auspicious—this is my good fortune alone; your subject reverently follows the canonical ritual.

sentences.zh: 」儐者出告。

translations.literal: " The usher came out to report.
translations.idiomatic: " The usher came out to report.

sentences.zh: 使者入，陳禮奠雁如儀，宣制曰：「奉制告吉。」

translations.literal: The envoy entered, displayed the gifts and presented the wild geese as in ritual, and proclaimed: "By imperial command I announce the auspicious result."
translations.idiomatic: The envoy entered, displayed the gifts and presented the wild geese as prescribed, and proclaimed: "By imperial command I announce the auspicious outcome."

sentences.zh: 又次納徵。

translations.literal: Next came the betrothal gifts.
translations.idiomatic: Next came the betrothal gifts.

sentences.zh: 儐者出告，使者入陳玉帛禮物，不奠雁，宣制曰：「某奉制告成。」

translations.literal: The usher came out to report; the envoy entered, displayed jade, silks, and gifts without presenting wild geese, and proclaimed: "I, So-and-so, by imperial command announce completion."
translations.idiomatic: The usher came out to report; the envoy entered, displayed jade, silks, and gifts without presenting wild geese, and proclaimed: "I, So-and-so, by imperial command announce completion."

sentences.zh: 又次請期。

translations.literal: Next came the request for the wedding date.
translations.idiomatic: Next came the request for the wedding date.

sentences.zh: 辭曰：「詢於龜筮。

translations.literal: The address read: "Having consulted tortoise and milfoil,
translations.idiomatic: The address read: "Having consulted tortoise and milfoil,

sentences.zh: 某月某日吉，制使某告期。

translations.literal: such-and-such a month and day are auspicious; by imperial command I, So-and-so, announce the date."
translations.idiomatic: such-and-such a month and day are auspicious; by imperial command I, So-and-so, announce the date."

sentences.zh: 」主婚者曰：「敢不承命。

translations.literal: " The chief of the wedding party said: "How dare I not accept the command?"
translations.idiomatic: " The bride's father said: "How dare I not accept the command?"

sentences.zh: 」陳禮奠雁如儀。

translations.literal: " Gifts were displayed and wild geese presented as in ritual.
translations.idiomatic: " Gifts were displayed and wild geese presented as prescribed.

sentences.zh: 又次告廟。

translations.literal: Next came the announcement to the ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: Next came the announcement to the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 遣使持節授冊寶儀注，悉見前。

translations.literal: The ritual procedures for dispatching envoys bearing the tally to present the investiture document and seal are all as set forth above.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual procedures for dispatching envoys bearing the tally to present the investiture and seal are all as set forth above.

sentences.zh: 又次醮戒。

translations.literal: Next came the libation and abstention rite.
translations.idiomatic: Next came the libation and abstention rite.

sentences.zh: 皇帝服通天冠、絳紗袍，御奉天殿，百官侍立。

translations.literal: The emperor wore the Heaven-Penetrating crown and crimson gauze robe, presided in the Hall of Reverent Heaven, and all officials stood in attendance.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wore the Heaven-Penetrating crown and crimson gauze robe, presided in the Hall of Reverent Heaven, and all officials stood in attendance.

sentences.zh: 引進導皇太子至丹陛，四拜。

translations.literal: An usher guided the crown prince to the vermillion steps, where he performed four prostrations.
translations.idiomatic: An usher guided the crown prince to the vermillion steps, where he made four prostrations.

sentences.zh: 入殿東門就席位，東向立。

translations.literal: He entered the hall's eastern gate, took his assigned place, and stood facing east.
translations.idiomatic: He entered the hall's eastern gate, took his assigned place, and stood facing east.

sentences.zh: 司爵以醆進，皇太子跪，搢圭，受醆祭酒。

translations.literal: The Master of Goblets presented the cup; the crown prince knelt, inserted the jade tablet, received the cup, and offered libation.
translations.idiomatic: The Master of Goblets presented the cup; the crown prince knelt, inserted the jade tablet, received the cup, and offered libation.

sentences.zh: 司饌以饌進，跪受亦如之。

translations.literal: The Master of Food presented the dishes; he knelt to receive them in the same way.
translations.idiomatic: The Master of Food presented the dishes; he knelt to receive them in the same way.

sentences.zh: 興，就席坐，飲食訖，導詣御座前跪。

translations.literal: He rose, took his seat, finished eating and drinking, was guided before the imperial throne, and knelt.
translations.idiomatic: He rose, took his seat, finished eating and drinking, was led before the imperial throne, and knelt.

sentences.zh: 皇帝命之曰：「往迎爾相，承我宗事，勖帥以敬。

translations.literal: The emperor charged him: "Go welcome your consort, undertake our ancestral duties, and lead her with reverence."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor charged him: "Go welcome your consort, undertake our ancestral duties, and lead her with reverence."

sentences.zh: 」皇太子曰：「臣某謹奉制旨。

translations.literal: " The crown prince said: "Your subject So-and-so reverently receives the imperial command."
translations.idiomatic: " The crown prince said: "Your subject So-and-so reverently receives the imperial command."

sentences.zh: 」俯伏，興。

translations.literal: " He prostrated himself and rose.
translations.idiomatic: " He prostrated himself and rose.

sentences.zh: 出至丹陛，四拜畢，皇帝還宮，皇太子出。

translations.literal: He went out to the vermillion steps; when the four prostrations were complete, the emperor returned to the palace and the crown prince departed.
translations.idiomatic: He went out to the vermillion steps; when the four prostrations were finished, the emperor returned to the palace and the crown prince departed.

sentences.zh: 又次親迎。

translations.literal: Next came the personal welcoming escort.
translations.idiomatic: Next came the personal welcoming escort.

sentences.zh: 前一日，有司設皇太子次於妃氏大門外，南向，東宮官次於南，東西相向。

translations.literal: On the previous day the responsible offices set up the crown prince's pavilion outside the bride's clan main gate, facing south; Eastern Palace officials' pavilions were set to the south, facing one another east and west.
translations.idiomatic: On the previous day the responsible offices erected the crown prince's pavilion outside the bride's clan main gate, facing south; Eastern Palace officials' pavilions were placed to the south, facing one another across the east-west axis.

sentences.zh: 至日質明，東宮官具朝服陳鹵簿鼓吹於東宮門外。

translations.literal: On the appointed day at dawn, Eastern Palace officials in court dress arrayed the guard of honor and musicians outside the Eastern Palace gate.
translations.idiomatic: On the appointed day at first light, Eastern Palace officials in court dress arrayed the guard of honor and musicians outside the Eastern Palace gate.

sentences.zh: 皇太子冕服乘輿出，侍衛導從如儀。

translations.literal: The crown prince in full ceremonial robes rode out in the carriage, with guards and escort according to ritual.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince, in full ceremonial robes, rode out in the carriage with guards and escort as prescribed.

sentences.zh: 至宮門降輿升輅，東宮官皆從至妃第，回轅南向，降輅升輿。

translations.literal: At the palace gate he descended from the carriage and mounted the chariot; Eastern Palace officials all followed to the princess-elect's residence; the chariot turned south, he descended and again mounted the carriage.
translations.idiomatic: At the palace gate he descended from the carriage and mounted the chariot; Eastern Palace officials all followed to the crown princess-elect's residence; the chariot turned south, he descended, and again mounted the carriage.

sentences.zh: 至次，降輿入就次，東宮官皆就次。

translations.literal: Upon reaching the pavilion he descended from the carriage, entered, and took his place; Eastern Palace officials all took their places.
translations.idiomatic: At the pavilion he descended from the carriage, entered, and took his place; Eastern Palace officials all took their places.

sentences.zh: 先是，皇太子將至，主婚者設會宴女。

translations.literal: Beforehand, when the crown prince was about to arrive, the chief of the wedding party prepared a feast for the bride.
translations.idiomatic: Beforehand, when the crown prince was about to arrive, the bride's father prepared a feast for the bride.

sentences.zh: 至期，妃服褕翟花釵，出就閣南面立，傅姆立於左右。

translations.literal: When the time came, the princess-elect in pheasant-embroidered robes and floral hairpins emerged to the chamber, stood facing south, and nurse-mothers stood to her left and right.
translations.idiomatic: When the time came, the crown princess-elect in pheasant-embroidered robes and floral hairpins emerged to the chamber, stood facing south, and nurse-mothers stood on either side.

sentences.zh: 主婚者具朝服立於西階之下。

translations.literal: The chief of the wedding party in court dress stood below the western steps.
translations.idiomatic: The bride's father, in court dress, stood below the western steps.

sentences.zh: 引進導皇太子出次，立於大門之東，西向。

translations.literal: An usher guided the crown prince out of the pavilion; he stood to the east of the main gate, facing west.
translations.idiomatic: An usher led the crown prince out of the pavilion; he stood to the east of the main gate, facing west.

sentences.zh: 儐者朝服出，立於門東曰：「敢請事。

translations.literal: The usher in court dress came out, stood to the east of the gate, and said: "I venture to ask your business."
translations.idiomatic: The usher in court dress came out, stood to the east of the gate, and said: "May I ask your business?"

sentences.zh: 」引進跪啓訖，皇太子曰：「某奉制親迎。

translations.literal: " The usher knelt to report; when he had finished, the crown prince said: "I, So-and-so, by imperial command come to welcome my bride in person."
translations.idiomatic: " The usher knelt to report; when he had finished, the crown prince said: "I, So-and-so, by imperial command come to welcome my bride in person."

sentences.zh: 」引進受命興，承傳於儐者。

translations.literal: " The usher received the command, rose, and relayed it to the usher at the gate.
translations.idiomatic: " The usher received the command, rose, and relayed it to the gate usher.

sentences.zh: 儐者入告，導主婚者出迎於大門外之西，東向再拜。

translations.literal: The usher went in to report and guided the chief of the wedding party out to welcome him to the west of the outer gate; facing east, he performed two prostrations.
translations.idiomatic: The usher went in to report and led the bride's father out to welcome him to the west of the outer gate; facing east, he made two prostrations.

sentences.zh: 皇太子答拜。

translations.literal: The crown prince returned the bow.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince returned the bow.

sentences.zh: 引進導皇太子入門而左，執雁者從。

translations.literal: The usher guided the crown prince through the gate to the left; the bearer of the wild geese followed.
translations.idiomatic: The usher led the crown prince through the gate to the left; the bearer of the wild geese followed.

sentences.zh: 儐者導主婚者入門而右。

translations.literal: The usher guided the chief of the wedding party through the gate to the right.
translations.idiomatic: The usher led the bride's father through the gate to the right.

sentences.zh: 皇太子升東階進，立於閣門戶前，北向立。

translations.literal: The crown prince ascended the eastern steps, advanced, and stood before the chamber door facing north.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince ascended the eastern steps, advanced, and stood before the chamber door facing north.

sentences.zh: 主婚者升西階，立於西，東向。

translations.literal: The bride's father ascended the western steps, stood on the west side, and faced east.
translations.idiomatic: The bride's father ascended the western steps, took his place on the west side, and faced east.

sentences.zh: 引進啓奠雁，執雁者以雁進。

translations.literal: The usher announced the wild geese presentation; the bearer of the wild geese advanced with the wild geese.
translations.idiomatic: The usher opened the wild geese presentation; the bearer of the wild geese advanced with them.

sentences.zh: 皇太子受雁，以授主婚者。

translations.literal: The crown prince received the wild geese and handed them to the bride's father.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince received the wild geese and presented them to the bride's father.

sentences.zh: 主婚者跪受，興，以授左右，退立於西。

translations.literal: The bride's father knelt to receive them, rose, handed them to attendants on either side, withdrew, and stood on the west side.
translations.idiomatic: The bride's father knelt to receive them, rose, passed them to attendants on either side, withdrew, and took his place on the west.

sentences.zh: 皇太子再拜，降自東階，出至次以伺。

translations.literal: The crown prince performed two prostrations, descended the eastern steps, went out to the pavilion, and waited.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince made two prostrations, descended the eastern steps, went out to the pavilion, and waited.

sentences.zh: 主婚者不降送。

translations.literal: The bride's father did not descend to see him off.
translations.idiomatic: The bride's father did not descend to see him off.

sentences.zh: 初，皇太子入門，妃母出，立於閣門外，奠雁位之西，南向。

translations.literal: Earlier, when the crown prince entered the gate, the crown princess-elect's mother came out and stood outside the chamber gate, to the west of the wild geese presentation position, facing south.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when the crown prince entered the gate, the crown princess-elect's mother came out and stood outside the chamber gate, west of the wild geese presentation position, facing south.

sentences.zh: 皇太子拜訖，宮人傅姆導妃出，立於母左。

translations.literal: When the crown prince's bow was complete, palace women and nurse-mothers guided the crown princess-elect out; she stood to her mother's left.
translations.idiomatic: When the crown prince had finished bowing, palace women and nurse-mothers led the crown princess-elect out; she stood to her mother's left.

sentences.zh: 主婚者命之曰：「戒之戒之，夙夜恪勤，毋或違命。

translations.literal: The bride's father charged her, saying: "Be warned and be warned; morning and night be reverently diligent, and do not disobey the command."
translations.idiomatic: The bride's father charged her: "Be warned—be warned; morning and night be reverently diligent, and never disobey the command."

sentences.zh: 」母命之曰：「勉之勉之，爾父有訓，往承惟欽。

translations.literal: " Her mother charged her, saying: "Strive and strive; your father has instructions—go forth and receive them with reverence."
translations.idiomatic: " Her mother charged her: "Strive—strive; your father has instructions—go forth and receive them with reverence."

sentences.zh: 」庶母申之曰：「恭聽父母之言。

translations.literal: " Her concubine-mother reiterated, saying: "Respectfully heed your parents' words."
translations.idiomatic: " Her concubine-mother added: "Respectfully heed your parents' words."

sentences.zh: 」宮人傅姆擎執導從，妃乘輿出門，降輿，乘鳳轎。

translations.literal: " Palace women and nurse-mothers held and guided her in attendance; the crown princess-elect mounted a carriage, went out through the gate, descended from the carriage, and mounted the phoenix sedan.
translations.idiomatic: " Palace women and nurse-mothers attended and guided her; the crown princess-elect mounted a carriage, went out through the gate, stepped down, and mounted the phoenix sedan.

sentences.zh: 皇太子揭簾訖，遂升輅，侍從如來儀。

translations.literal: When the crown prince had lifted the curtain, he mounted the chariot; his attendants followed as on the outward journey.
translations.idiomatic: After the crown prince had lifted the curtain, he mounted the chariot; his attendants followed as on the outward journey.

sentences.zh: 至東宮門外，降輅乘輿。

translations.literal: At the gate of the Eastern Palace, he descended from the chariot and mounted a carriage.
translations.idiomatic: At the Eastern Palace gate, he descended from the chariot and mounted a carriage.

sentences.zh: 至閣，降輿入，俟於內殿門外之東，西面。

translations.literal: At the pavilion, he descended from the carriage and entered; he waited to the east outside the inner hall gate, facing west.
translations.idiomatic: At the pavilion, he stepped down and entered; he waited east of the inner hall gate, facing west.

sentences.zh: 司閨導妃詣內殿門外之西，東面。

translations.literal: The Director of the Inner Chambers guided the crown princess-elect to the west outside the inner hall gate, facing east.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of the Inner Chambers led the crown princess-elect to the west side outside the inner hall gate, facing east.

sentences.zh: 皇太子揖妃入，行合巹禮，如中宮儀。

translations.literal: The crown prince bowed to receive the crown princess-elect and led her in; they performed the nuptial cup rite as in the empress's ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince bowed and received the crown princess-elect inside; they performed the nuptial cup ceremony according to the empress's rite.

sentences.zh: 又次朝見。

translations.literal: Next came the court audience.
translations.idiomatic: Next came the court audience.

sentences.zh: 其日，妃詣內殿陛下，候皇帝升座。

translations.literal: On that day, the crown princess-elect went below the steps of the inner hall and waited for the emperor to ascend the throne.
translations.idiomatic: That day the crown princess-elect went to the foot of the inner hall's steps and waited for the emperor to take the throne.

sentences.zh: 司閨導妃入，北面立，再拜，自西階升。

translations.literal: The Director of the Inner Chambers guided the crown princess-elect in; she stood facing north, performed two prostrations, and ascended by the western steps.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of the Inner Chambers led the crown princess-elect in; she stood facing north, made two prostrations, and ascended the western steps.

sentences.zh: 宮人奉棗慄盤，進至御座前授妃。

translations.literal: A palace woman bore a tray of dates and chestnuts, advanced to before the imperial throne, and handed it to the crown princess-elect.
translations.idiomatic: A palace woman bore a tray of dates and chestnuts, advanced to the imperial throne, and handed it to the crown princess-elect.

sentences.zh: 妃奠於御前，退復位，再拜。

translations.literal: The crown princess-elect presented it before the throne, withdrew to her place, and performed two prostrations.
translations.idiomatic: The crown princess-elect presented it before the throne, withdrew to her place, and made two prostrations.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，詣皇后前，奉腶修盤，如上儀。

translations.literal: When the rite was complete, she went before the empress and presented a tray of salted and dried meats, as in the ceremony above.
translations.idiomatic: When the rite was finished, she went before the empress and presented a tray of salted and dried meats, as before.

sentences.zh: 又次醴妃，次盥饋，次謁廟，次羣臣命婦朝賀，皆如儀。

translations.literal: Next came presenting sweet wine to the crown princess-elect, then the hand-washing and food-offering rite, then visiting the ancestral temple, then congratulations from officials and titled ladies—all as prescribed.
translations.idiomatic: Next came the sweet-wine presentation to the crown princess-elect, then the hand-washing and food-offering rite, then the temple visit, then congratulations from officials and titled ladies—all as prescribed.

sentences.zh: 四年，冊開平王常遇春女爲皇太子妃。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, the daughter of the Prince of Kaiping, Chang Yuchun, was invested as crown princess.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, the daughter of Chang Yuchun, Prince of Kaiping, was invested as crown princess.

sentences.zh: 禮部上儀注，太祖覽之曰：「贄禮不用笄，但用金盤，翟車用鳳轎，雁以玉爲之。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Rites submitted the ritual protocol; the founding emperor reviewed it and said: "For the gift presentation rite, do not use hairpins—use only a gold tray; replace the pheasant-embroidered carriage with the phoenix sedan; the wild geese should be made of jade."
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Rites submitted the ritual protocol; the founding emperor reviewed it and said: "For the gift presentation, do not use hairpins—use only a gold tray; replace the pheasant-embroidered carriage with the phoenix sedan; the wild geese should be made of jade."

sentences.zh: 古禮有親迎執綏御輪，今用轎，則揭簾是矣。

translations.literal: In ancient rites the groom in personal welcome held the bridle and turned the wheel; now that a sedan is used, lifting the curtain suffices.
translations.idiomatic: Ancient rites had the groom in personal welcome hold the bridle and turn the wheel; now that a sedan is used, lifting the curtain suffices.

sentences.zh: 其合巹，依古制用匏。

translations.literal: For the nuptial cups, follow the ancient system and use gourds.
translations.idiomatic: For the nuptial cups, follow the ancient system and use gourds.

sentences.zh: 妃朝見，入宮中，乘小車，以帷幕蔽之。

translations.literal: When the crown princess-elect paid court audience and entered the palace, she rode in a small carriage screened by curtains.
translations.idiomatic: When the crown princess-elect paid court audience and entered the palace, she rode in a small carriage screened by curtains.

sentences.zh: 謁廟，則皇太子俱往。

translations.literal: For the temple visit, the crown prince should go together with her.
translations.idiomatic: For the temple visit, the crown prince should accompany her.

sentences.zh: 禮成後三日，乃宴羣臣命婦。

translations.literal: Three days after the rites were complete, only then should officials and titled ladies be banqueted.
translations.idiomatic: Only three days after the rites were complete should officials and titled ladies be banqueted.

sentences.zh: 」著爲令。

translations.literal: " This was established as a regulation.
translations.idiomatic: " This was established as a regulation.

sentences.zh: 成化二十二年，更定婚禮。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year of Chenghua, the wedding rites were revised.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year of Chenghua, the wedding rites were revised.

sentences.zh: 凡節冊等案，俱由奉天左門出。

translations.literal: In general, the tables for tally staves, commission documents, and the like all passed out through the left gate of the Gate of Receiving Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: In general, the tally, commission, and related tables all passed out through the left gate of the Gate of Receiving Heaven.

sentences.zh: 皇太子親迎，由東長安門出。

translations.literal: When the crown prince went in personal welcome, he departed through the Eastern Chang'an Gate.
translations.idiomatic: When the crown prince went in personal welcome, he departed through the Eastern Chang'an Gate.

sentences.zh: 親迎日，妃服燕居服，隨父母家廟行禮。

translations.literal: On the day of personal welcome, the crown princess-elect wore everyday dress and followed her parents to the family ancestral shrine to perform the rites.
translations.idiomatic: On the day of personal welcome, the crown princess-elect wore everyday dress and followed her parents to the family ancestral shrine to perform the rites.

sentences.zh: 執事者具酒饌，妃飲食訖。

translations.literal: Attendants prepared wine and food; when the crown princess-elect had finished eating and drinking.
translations.idiomatic: Attendants prepared wine and food; when the crown princess-elect had finished eating and drinking.

sentences.zh: 父母坐堂上，妃詣前各四拜。

translations.literal: Her parents sat in the hall; the crown princess-elect went before each and performed four prostrations.
translations.idiomatic: Her parents sat in the hall; the crown princess-elect went before each and made four prostrations.

sentences.zh: 父命之曰：「爾往大內，夙夜勤慎，孝敬無違。

translations.literal: Her father charged her, saying: "When you go to the inner palace, morning and night be diligent and careful; in filial reverence do not transgress."
translations.idiomatic: Her father charged her: "When you go to the inner palace, morning and night be diligent and careful; in filial reverence, do not transgress."

sentences.zh: 」母命之曰：「爾父有訓，爾當敬承。

translations.literal: " Her mother charged her, saying: "Your father has instructions; you must respectfully receive them."
translations.idiomatic: " Her mother charged her: "Your father has instructions; you must respectfully receive them."

sentences.zh: 」合巹前，於皇太子內殿各設拜位。

translations.literal: " Before the nuptial cups, obeisance positions were set out for each in the crown prince's inner hall.
translations.idiomatic: " Before the nuptial cups, obeisance positions were set out for each in the crown prince's inner hall.

sentences.zh: 皇太子揖妃入就位，再拜，妃四拜，然後各升座。

translations.literal: The crown prince bowed to receive the crown princess-elect and led her to her place; he performed two prostrations, she four prostrations, and then each ascended to a seat.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince bowed and received the crown princess-elect to their places; he made two prostrations, she four, and then each took a seat.

sentences.zh: 廟見後，百官朝賀，致詞曰：「某官臣某等，恭惟皇太子嘉禮既成，益綿宗社隆長之福。

translations.literal: After the temple audience, the hundred officials offered congratulations, saying: "We officials So-and-so and others respectfully consider that the crown prince's auspicious rite is now complete, and the blessings of the ancestral temple and state will be ever lengthened and increased."
translations.idiomatic: After the temple audience, officials offered congratulations, saying: "We officials So-and-so and others respectfully consider that the crown prince's auspicious rite is now complete, and the blessings of the ancestral temple and state will be ever lengthened and increased."

sentences.zh: 臣某等不勝欣忭之至，謹當慶賀。

translations.literal: We, your subjects So-and-so and others, are overcome with joy beyond measure and respectfully offer our congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: We, your subjects So-and-so and others, are overcome with joy and respectfully offer our congratulations.

sentences.zh: 」帝賜宴如正旦儀。

translations.literal: " The emperor granted a banquet as on New Year's Day.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor granted a banquet as on New Year's Day.

sentences.zh: 命婦詣太后皇后前賀，亦賜宴，致詞曰：「皇太子嘉聘禮成，益綿景福。

translations.literal: Titled ladies went before the empress dowager and empress to offer congratulations; they too were granted banquets, saying: "The crown prince's auspicious betrothal rite is complete; may blessings and good fortune ever increase."
translations.idiomatic: Titled ladies went before the empress dowager and empress to offer congratulations and were also granted banquets, saying: "The crown prince's auspicious betrothal rite is complete; may blessings and good fortune ever increase."

sentences.zh: 」餘大率如洪武儀。

translations.literal: " The rest followed the Hongwu rites in general.
translations.idiomatic: " The rest followed the Hongwu rites in general.

sentences.zh: 親王婚禮

translations.literal: Wedding Rites for Imperial Princes
translations.idiomatic: Princely Wedding Rites

sentences.zh: 唐制，皇子納妃，命親王主婚。

translations.literal: Under the Tang system, when an imperial son received a consort, an imperial prince was appointed to preside over the wedding.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Tang system, when an imperial son received a consort, an imperial prince was appointed to preside over the wedding.

sentences.zh: 宋皆皇帝臨軒醮戒，略與皇太子同。

translations.literal: Under the Song, the emperor always received them at the imperial hall for the farewell libation and admonition, broadly the same as for the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Song, the emperor always received them at the imperial hall for the farewell libation and admonition, broadly the same as for the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 明因之。

translations.literal: The Ming followed this.
translations.idiomatic: The Ming followed this.

sentences.zh: 其宣制曰：「冊某氏爲某王妃。

translations.literal: The proclamation of the command read: "Invest Lady Such-and-such as princess consort of Prince Such-and-such."
translations.idiomatic: The proclamation read: "Invest Lady Such-and-such as princess consort of Prince Such-and-such."

sentences.zh: 」納采，致詞曰：「某王之儷，屬於懿淑，使某行納采禮。

translations.literal: " For betrothal gifts, the address read: "The consort of Prince Such-and-such belongs to one of gracious virtue; I am sent to perform the betrothal gift rite."
translations.idiomatic: " For betrothal gifts, the address read: "The consort of Prince Such-and-such belongs to one of gracious virtue; I am sent to perform the betrothal gift rite."

sentences.zh: 」問名詞曰：「某既受命，將加諸卜筮協從，使某告吉。

translations.literal: " The name-inquiry address read: "Having received the command, I, So-and-so, will consult divination for concord; I am sent to announce the auspicious result."
translations.idiomatic: " The name-inquiry address read: "Having received the command, I, So-and-so, will consult divination for concord; I am sent to announce the auspicious outcome."

sentences.zh: 」主婚者曰： 「制以臣某之子，可以奉侍某王，臣某不敢辭。

translations.literal: " The bride's father said: "The command designates my son as fit to serve Prince Such-and-such; your subject So-and-so dares not decline."
translations.idiomatic: " The bride's father said: "The command designates my daughter as fit to serve Prince Such-and-such; your subject So-and-so dares not decline."

sentences.zh: 」納吉詞曰：「卜筮協從，使某告吉。

translations.literal: " The auspicious-confirmation address read: "The divination agrees in concord; I am sent to announce the auspicious result."
translations.idiomatic: " The auspicious-confirmation address read: "The divination agrees in concord; I am sent to announce the auspicious outcome."

sentences.zh: 」主婚者曰：「臣某之子，愚弗克堪。

translations.literal: " The bride's father said: "Your subject's son is dull and unworthy."
translations.idiomatic: " The bride's father said: "Your subject's daughter is dull and unworthy."

sentences.zh: 卜貺之吉，臣與有幸，謹奉典制。
