translations.literal: The auspicious gift of divination—your subject is fortunate; I respectfully receive the ritual regulations.
translations.idiomatic: The divination's auspicious gift—your subject is fortunate; I respectfully receive the prescribed rites.

sentences.zh: 」納徵詞曰：「某王之儷，卜既協吉，制使某以儀物告成。

translations.literal: " The betrothal gift address read: "The consort of Prince Such-and-such—the divination having agreed on an auspicious day—by command I, So-and-so, announce completion with ceremonial gifts."
translations.idiomatic: " The betrothal gift address read: "The consort of Prince Such-and-such—the divination having agreed on an auspicious day—by command I, So-and-so, announce completion with ceremonial gifts."

sentences.zh: 」主婚者曰：「奉制賜臣以重禮，臣某謹奉典制。

translations.literal: " The bride's father said: "Receiving by command the gift of heavy ceremony to your subject, your subject So-and-so respectfully receives the ritual regulations."
translations.idiomatic: " The bride's father said: "Receiving by command such weighty ceremonial gifts, your subject So-and-so respectfully receives the prescribed rites."

sentences.zh: 」請期詞曰：「某月日涓吉，制使某告期。

translations.literal: " The date-announcement address read: "On such-and-such month and day an auspicious date has been chosen; by command I, So-and-so, announce the date."
translations.idiomatic: " The date-announcement address read: "On such-and-such month and day an auspicious date has been chosen; by command I, So-and-so, announce the date."

sentences.zh: 」主婚者曰： 「謹奉命。

translations.literal: " The bride's father said: "I respectfully accept the command."
translations.idiomatic: " The bride's father said: "I respectfully accept the command."

sentences.zh: 」醮戒命曰：「往迎爾相，用承厥家，勖帥以敬。

translations.literal: " The farewell libation admonition read: "Go forth to welcome your mate; thereby uphold the household; take the lead in reverence."
translations.idiomatic: " The farewell libation admonition read: "Go forth to welcome your mate; thereby uphold the household; take the lead in reverence."

sentences.zh: 」其親迎、合巹、朝見、盥饋，並如皇太子。

translations.literal: " Personal welcome, nuptial cups, court audience, and hand-washing and food-offering—all were the same as for the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: " Personal welcome, nuptial cups, court audience, and hand-washing and food-offering—all followed the crown prince's rites.

sentences.zh: 盥饋畢，王皮弁服，妃翟衣，詣東宮前，行四拜禮。

translations.literal: When the hand-washing and food-offering rite was complete, the prince in leather cap and the princess consort in pheasant-embroidered robes went before the Eastern Palace and performed four prostrations.
translations.idiomatic: When the hand-washing and food-offering rite was finished, the prince in leather cap and the princess consort in pheasant-embroidered robes went before the Eastern Palace and made four prostrations.

sentences.zh: 東宮坐受，東宮妃立受二拜，答二拜。

translations.literal: The Eastern Palace heir received them seated; the crown princess received standing, accepting two prostrations and returning two.
translations.idiomatic: The Eastern Palace heir received them seated; the crown princess received standing, accepting two prostrations and returning two.

sentences.zh: 王與妃至妃家，妃父出迎。

translations.literal: When the prince and princess consort arrived at her family home, her father came out to welcome them.
translations.idiomatic: When the prince and princess consort arrived at her family home, her father came out to welcome them.

sentences.zh: 王先入，妃父從之。

translations.literal: The prince entered first; her father followed him.
translations.idiomatic: The prince entered first; her father followed him.

sentences.zh: 至堂，王立於東，妃父母立於西。

translations.literal: At the hall, the prince stood on the east; her parents stood on the west.
translations.idiomatic: At the hall, the prince stood on the east; her parents stood on the west.

sentences.zh: 王四拜，妃父母立受二拜，答二拜。

translations.literal: The prince performed four prostrations; her parents received standing, accepting two prostrations and returning two.
translations.idiomatic: The prince made four prostrations; her parents received standing, accepting two prostrations and returning two.

sentences.zh: 王中坐，其餘親屬見王，四拜，王皆坐受。

translations.literal: The prince sat in the central seat; the remaining kinsmen, on meeting the prince, performed four prostrations, and the prince received them all seated.
translations.idiomatic: The prince sat in the central seat; the remaining kinsmen, on meeting the prince, made four prostrations, and the prince received them all seated.

sentences.zh: 妃入中堂，妃父母坐，妃四拜。

translations.literal: The princess consort entered the central hall; her parents sat; she performed four prostrations.
translations.idiomatic: The princess consort entered the central hall; her parents sat; she made four prostrations.

sentences.zh: 其餘序家人禮。

translations.literal: The rest followed the order of family rites.
translations.idiomatic: The rest followed the order of family rites.

sentences.zh: 太祖之世，皇太子、皇子有二妃。

translations.literal: In the founding emperor's reign, the crown prince and imperial sons each had two consorts.
translations.idiomatic: In the founding emperor's reign, the crown prince and imperial sons each had two consorts.

sentences.zh: 洪武八年十一月，徵衛國公鄧愈女爲秦王次妃，不傳制，不發冊，不親迎。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the eighth year of Hongwu, the daughter of Duke of Weiguo, Deng Yu, was summoned as secondary consort of the Prince of Qin; no edict was transmitted, no commission issued, and no personal welcome performed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the eighth year of Hongwu, the daughter of Duke of Weiguo, Deng Yu, was summoned as secondary consort of the Prince of Qin; no edict was transmitted, no commission issued, and no personal welcome was performed.

sentences.zh: 正副使行納徵禮，冠服擬唐、宋二品之制，儀仗視正妃稍減。

translations.literal: The chief and deputy envoys performed the betrothal gift rite; caps and robes followed the Tang and Song second-rank system; ceremonial guard was slightly reduced from that for the principal consort.
translations.idiomatic: The chief and deputy envoys performed the betrothal gift rite; caps and robes followed the Tang and Song second-rank system; ceremonial guard was slightly reduced from that for the principal consort.

sentences.zh: 婚之日，王皮弁服，導妃謁奉先殿。

translations.literal: On the wedding day, the prince in leather cap guided the consort to pay respects at the Hall of Imperial Ancestors.
translations.idiomatic: On the wedding day, the prince in leather cap guided the consort to pay respects at the Hall of Imperial Ancestors.

sentences.zh: 王在東稍前，妃西稍後。

translations.literal: The prince stood slightly forward on the east; the consort slightly behind on the west.
translations.idiomatic: The prince stood slightly forward on the east; the consort slightly behind on the west.

sentences.zh: 禮畢入宮，王與正妃正坐，次妃詣王前四拜，復詣正妃前四拜。

translations.literal: When the rite was complete they entered the palace; the prince and principal consort sat in the central seats; the secondary consort went before the prince and performed four prostrations, then before the principal consort and performed four prostrations.
translations.idiomatic: When the rite was finished they entered the palace; the prince and principal consort sat in the central seats; the secondary consort went before the prince and made four prostrations, then before the principal consort and made four prostrations.

sentences.zh: 次妃東坐，宴飲成禮。

translations.literal: The secondary consort sat on the east; drinking and feasting completed the rite.
translations.idiomatic: The secondary consort sat on the east; drinking and feasting completed the rite.

sentences.zh: 次日朝見，拜位如謁殿。

translations.literal: The next day she paid court audience; obeisance positions were as for visiting the hall.
translations.idiomatic: The next day she paid court audience; obeisance positions were as for visiting the hall.

sentences.zh: 謁中宮，不用棗慄腶修，餘並同。

translations.literal: For visiting the central palace, dates, chestnuts, salted meat, and dried meat were not used; the rest was the same.
translations.idiomatic: For visiting the empress, dates, chestnuts, salted meat, and dried meat were not used; the rest was the same.

sentences.zh: 公主婚禮

translations.literal: Wedding Rites for Imperial Princesses
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Princess Wedding Rites

sentences.zh: 古者天子嫁女，不自主婚，以同姓諸侯主之，故曰公主。

translations.literal: In antiquity, when the Son of Heaven gave a daughter in marriage, he did not himself preside over the wedding; a feudal lord of the same surname presided, hence the title "princess."
translations.idiomatic: In antiquity, when the Son of Heaven gave a daughter in marriage, he did not himself preside over the wedding; a feudal lord of the same surname presided, hence the title "princess."

sentences.zh: 唐猶以親王主婚。

translations.literal: Under the Tang, an imperial prince still presided over the wedding.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Tang, an imperial prince still presided over the wedding.

sentences.zh: 宋始不用，惟令掌婚者於內東門納表，則天子自爲主矣。

translations.literal: Under the Song this was first abandoned; only the superintendent of the wedding was ordered to submit the memorial at the Inner Eastern Gate, and thus the Son of Heaven himself became the presiding host.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Song this was first abandoned; only the superintendent of the wedding was ordered to submit the memorial at the Inner Eastern Gate, and thus the Son of Heaven himself became the presiding host.

sentences.zh: 明因之。

translations.literal: The Ming followed this.
translations.idiomatic: The Ming followed this.

sentences.zh: 凡公主出降，行納采問名禮，婿家備禮物表文於家庭，望闕再拜。

translations.literal: Generally, when an imperial princess was given in marriage, betrothal gift and name-inquiry rites were performed; the groom's family prepared gifts and a memorial at home and bowed twice toward the palace.
translations.idiomatic: Generally, when an imperial princess was given in marriage, betrothal gift and name-inquiry rites were performed; the groom's family prepared gifts and a memorial at home and bowed twice toward the palace.

sentences.zh: 掌婚者奉至內東門，詣內使前曰：「朝恩貺室於某官某之子，某習先人之禮，使臣某請納采。

translations.literal: The superintendent of the wedding bore them to the Inner Eastern Gate, went before the inner attendant, and said: "Imperial grace has bestowed a chamber upon the son of Official So-and-so; I, So-and-so, versed in my ancestors' rites, send your subject So-and-so to request betrothal gifts."
translations.idiomatic: The superintendent of the wedding bore them to the Inner Eastern Gate, went before the inner attendant, and said: "Imperial grace has bestowed a chamber upon the son of Official So-and-so; I, So-and-so, versed in my ancestors' rites, send your subject So-and-so to request betrothal gifts."

sentences.zh: 」 以表跪授內使。

translations.literal: " He knelt and handed the memorial to the inner attendant.
translations.idiomatic: " He knelt and handed the memorial to the inner attendant.

sentences.zh: 內使跪受，奉進內殿，執雁及禮物者從入。

translations.literal: The inner attendant knelt to receive it, bore it into the inner hall, and those bearing the wild geese and gifts followed in.
translations.idiomatic: The inner attendant knelt to receive it, bore it into the inner hall, and those bearing the wild geese and gifts followed in.

sentences.zh: 內使出，掌婚者曰：「將加卜筮，使臣某問名。

translations.literal: The inner attendant came out; the superintendent of the wedding said: "I will consult divination next; I send your subject So-and-so to inquire the name."
translations.idiomatic: The inner attendant came out; the superintendent of the wedding said: "I will consult divination next; I send your subject So-and-so to inquire the name."

sentences.zh: 」進表如初，內使出曰：「有制。

translations.literal: " He presented the memorial as before; the inner attendant came out and said: "There is an imperial command."
translations.idiomatic: " He presented the memorial as before; the inner attendant came out and said: "There is an imperial command."

sentences.zh: 」掌婚者跪，內使宣曰；

translations.literal: " The superintendent of the wedding knelt; the inner attendant proclaimed:
translations.idiomatic: " The superintendent of the wedding knelt; the inner attendant proclaimed:

sentences.zh: 「皇帝第幾女，封某公主。

translations.literal: "The emperor's such-and-such-numbered daughter is enfeoffed as Princess Such-and-such."
translations.idiomatic: "The emperor's such-and-such-numbered daughter is enfeoffed as Princess Such-and-such."

sentences.zh: 」掌婚者俯伏，興。

translations.literal: " The superintendent of the wedding prostrated himself and rose.
translations.idiomatic: " The superintendent of the wedding prostrated himself and rose.

sentences.zh: 入就次，賜宴出。

translations.literal: He entered the pavilion; a banquet was granted, and he departed.
translations.idiomatic: He entered the pavilion; a banquet was granted, and he departed.

sentences.zh: 納吉儀與納采同。

translations.literal: The auspicious-confirmation rite was the same as the betrothal gift rite.
translations.idiomatic: The auspicious-confirmation rite was the same as the betrothal gift rite.

sentences.zh: 掌婚者致詞曰：「加諸卜筮，佔曰從吉，謹使臣某敢告納徵。

translations.literal: The superintendent of the wedding addressed, saying: "Having consulted divination, the augury reads concord with auspiciousness; I respectfully send your subject So-and-so to announce the betrothal gifts."
translations.idiomatic: The superintendent of the wedding addressed, saying: "Having consulted divination, the augury reads concord with auspiciousness; I respectfully send your subject So-and-so to announce the betrothal gifts."

sentences.zh: 」婿傢俱玄纁、玉帛、乘馬、表文如儀。

translations.literal: " The groom's escort all brought dark-red and light-red silks, jade and silks, horses, and the memorial, as prescribed.
translations.idiomatic: " The groom's escort all brought dark-red and light-red silks, jade and silks, horses, and the memorial, as prescribed.

sentences.zh: 掌婚者致詞曰：「朝恩貺室於某官某之子某，有先人之禮，使臣某以束帛、乘馬納徵。

translations.literal: The superintendent of the wedding addressed, saying: "Imperial grace has bestowed a chamber upon the son of Official So-and-so, So-and-so; observing my ancestors' rites, I send your subject So-and-so to present betrothal gifts of silk bundles and horses."
translations.idiomatic: The superintendent of the wedding addressed, saying: "By imperial grace a marriage alliance has been granted to the son of Official So-and-so, So-and-so; in accordance with ancestral rites, I send your subject So-and-so to present betrothal gifts of silk bundles and horses."

sentences.zh: 」請期詞曰：「某命臣某謹請吉日。」

translations.literal: " The speech for requesting the date said: "So-and-so orders your subject So-and-so respectfully to request an auspicious day."
translations.idiomatic: " The speech for requesting the wedding date said: "So-and-so orders your subject So-and-so respectfully to request an auspicious day."

sentences.zh: 親迎日，婿公服告廟曰：「國恩貺室於某，以某日親迎，敢告。

translations.literal: On the day of personal welcome, the groom in official dress announced at the ancestral temple, saying: "National grace has bestowed a chamber upon So-and-so; on such-and-such a day I will personally welcome her— I respectfully announce."
translations.idiomatic: On the day of the personal welcome, the groom in official dress announced at the ancestral temple, saying: "By the grace of the state a marriage alliance has been granted to So-and-so; on such-and-such a day I will go in person to welcome her— I respectfully announce this."

sentences.zh: 」將行，父醮於廳，隨意致戒。

translations.literal: " When he was about to depart, his father performed the libation in the hall and admonished him as he saw fit.
translations.idiomatic: " When he was about to set out, his father performed the libation in the hall and offered such admonitions as he thought fit.

sentences.zh: 婿再拜出，至內東門內。

translations.literal: The groom performed two prostrations and departed, reaching inside the Inner Eastern Gate.
translations.idiomatic: The groom made two prostrations and left, proceeding to the inside of the Inner Eastern Gate.

sentences.zh: 內使延入次，執雁及奉禮物者各陳於庭。

translations.literal: The inner attendant invited him into the pavilion; those bearing wild geese and those presenting gifts each displayed them in the courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: An inner attendant invited him into the pavilion; those carrying wild geese and those bearing ceremonial gifts each laid out their offerings in the courtyard.

sentences.zh: 其日，公主禮服辭奉先殿，詣帝后前四拜，受爵。

translations.literal: That day, the imperial princess in ceremonial dress took leave at the Hall of Imperial Ancestors, went before the emperor and empress and performed four prostrations, and received libation.
translations.idiomatic: That day, the imperial princess in full ceremonial dress took leave at the Hall of Imperial Ancestors, went before the emperor and empress and made four prostrations, and received the libation.

sentences.zh: 帝后隨意訓戒。

translations.literal: The emperor and empress admonished her as they saw fit.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor and empress offered such instruction and admonition as they thought fit.

sentences.zh: 受命訖，又四拜。

translations.literal: When reception of the command was complete, she performed four prostrations again.
translations.idiomatic: When she had received their charge, she made four prostrations again.

sentences.zh: 降階，內命婦送至內殿門外，公主升輦。

translations.literal: Descending the steps, inner palace ladies escorted her to outside the inner hall gate; the imperial princess mounted the palanquin.
translations.idiomatic: She descended the steps; inner palace ladies escorted her to the outer gate of the inner hall, and the imperial princess mounted her palanquin.

sentences.zh: 至內東門，降輦。

translations.literal: Reaching the Inner Eastern Gate, she descended from the palanquin.
translations.idiomatic: When she reached the Inner Eastern Gate, she descended from the palanquin.

sentences.zh: 婿揭簾，公主升轎。

translations.literal: The groom lifted the curtain; the imperial princess mounted the sedan chair.
translations.idiomatic: The groom raised the curtain, and the imperial princess entered the sedan chair.

sentences.zh: 婿出次立。

translations.literal: The groom came out of the pavilion and stood.
translations.idiomatic: The groom stepped out of the pavilion and stood waiting.

sentences.zh: 執雁者以雁跪授婿，婿受雁，跪進於內使。

translations.literal: The wild-goose bearer knelt and presented the geese to the groom; the groom received the geese and knelt to present them to the inner attendant.
translations.idiomatic: The bearer of the wild geese knelt and handed them to the groom; the groom received them and, kneeling, presented them to the inner attendant.

sentences.zh: 內使跪受以授左右。

translations.literal: The inner attendant knelt to receive them and handed them to attendants on the left and right.
translations.idiomatic: The inner attendant knelt to receive them and passed them to attendants on either side.

sentences.zh: 婿再拜，先出，乘馬還。

translations.literal: The groom performed two prostrations, departed first, mounted a horse, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: The groom made two prostrations, went out ahead of her, mounted his horse, and rode back.

sentences.zh: 公主鹵簿車輅後發，公侯百官命婦送至府。

translations.literal: The imperial princess's guard of honor and carriage set out afterward; dukes, marquises, ranked officials, and palace ladies escorted her to the residence.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial princess's guard of honor and carriage followed afterward; dukes, marquises, ranked officials, and palace ladies escorted her to the residence.

sentences.zh: 婿先候於門。

translations.literal: The groom waited first at the gate.
translations.idiomatic: The groom waited first at the gate.

sentences.zh: 公主至，婿揭簾。

translations.literal: When the imperial princess arrived, the groom lifted the curtain.
translations.idiomatic: When the imperial princess arrived, the groom raised the curtain.

sentences.zh: 公主降，同詣祠堂。

translations.literal: The imperial princess descended; together they proceeded to the ancestral shrine.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial princess alighted, and together they went to the ancestral shrine.

sentences.zh: 婿東，公主西，皆再拜。

translations.literal: The groom on the east, the imperial princess on the west— both performed two prostrations.
translations.idiomatic: The groom stood on the east, the imperial princess on the west, and both made two prostrations.

sentences.zh: 進爵，讀祝，又再拜。

translations.literal: Wine was presented, the prayer was read, and they performed two prostrations again.
translations.idiomatic: Wine was offered, the prayer was read aloud, and they made two prostrations again.

sentences.zh: 出，詣寢室。

translations.literal: They exited and proceeded to the bridal chamber.
translations.idiomatic: They left and went to the bridal chamber.

sentences.zh: 婿公主相向再拜，各就坐，婿東，公主西。

translations.literal: Groom and imperial princess faced each other and performed two prostrations; each took a seat— groom east, imperial princess west.
translations.idiomatic: The groom and imperial princess faced each other and made two prostrations; each then took a seat— the groom on the east, the imperial princess on the west.

sentences.zh: 進饌合巹如儀，復相向再拜。

translations.literal: Food and joined nuptial cups were presented as prescribed; they faced each other and performed two prostrations again.
translations.idiomatic: Food and the joined nuptial cups were presented according to ritual; they faced each other and made two prostrations again.

sentences.zh: 明日，見舅姑。

translations.literal: The next day, meeting the parents-in-law.
translations.idiomatic: The next day she met her parents-in-law.

sentences.zh: 舅姑坐於東，西向。

translations.literal: The parents-in-law sat on the east, facing west.
translations.idiomatic: Her parents-in-law sat on the east side, facing west.

sentences.zh: 公主立於西，東向，行四拜禮。

translations.literal: The imperial princess stood on the west, facing east, and performed the four-prostration rite.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial princess stood on the west, facing east, and performed the four-prostration rite.

sentences.zh: 舅姑答二拜。

translations.literal: The parents-in-law returned two prostrations.
translations.idiomatic: Her parents-in-law returned two prostrations.

sentences.zh: 第十日，駙馬朝見謝恩，行五拜禮。

translations.literal: On the tenth day, the imperial son-in-law attended court to express gratitude, performing the five-prostration rite.
translations.idiomatic: On the tenth day, the imperial son-in-law attended court to express his gratitude, performing the five-prostration rite.

sentences.zh: 初，洪武九年，太祖以太師李善長子祺爲駙馬都尉，尚臨安公主。

translations.literal: Initially, in the ninth year of Hongwu, the founding emperor appointed Li Shanchang's son Qi as Chief Imperial Consort-in-Law and betrothed him to Princess Lin'an.
translations.idiomatic: At first, in the ninth year of Hongwu, the founding emperor appointed Li Shanchang's son Qi Chief Imperial Consort-in-Law and betrothed him to Princess Lin'an.

sentences.zh: 先期告奉先殿。

translations.literal: In advance they announced at the Hall of Imperial Ancestors.
translations.idiomatic: In advance they made announcement at the Hall of Imperial Ancestors.

sentences.zh: 下嫁前二日，命使冊公主。

translations.literal: Two days before the princess descended in marriage, envoys were ordered to invest the imperial princess.
translations.idiomatic: Two days before the princess's descent in marriage, envoys were dispatched to invest the imperial princess.

sentences.zh: 冊後次日，謁奉先殿。

translations.literal: The day after investiture, they paid respects at the Hall of Imperial Ancestors.
translations.idiomatic: The day after the investiture, they paid respects at the Hall of Imperial Ancestors.

sentences.zh: 又定駙馬受誥儀，吏部官捧誥命置龍亭，至太師府，駙馬朝服拜受。

translations.literal: They also established the rite for the imperial son-in-law's reception of the edict of appointment: a Ministry of Personnel official bore the edict and commission, placed them in the dragon pavilion, went to the Grand Mentor's residence, and the imperial son-in-law in court dress bowed to receive them.
translations.idiomatic: They also fixed the rite by which the imperial son-in-law received his edict of appointment: a Ministry of Personnel official bore the edict and commission, placed them in the dragon pavilion, proceeded to the Grand Mentor's residence, and the imperial son-in-law in court dress bowed to receive them.

sentences.zh: 次日，善長及駙馬謝恩。

translations.literal: The next day, Shanchang and the imperial son-in-law expressed gratitude.
translations.idiomatic: The next day, Shanchang and the imperial son-in-law went to express their gratitude.

sentences.zh: 後十日，始請婚期。

translations.literal: Ten days later, they first requested the wedding date.
translations.idiomatic: Ten days later they first requested the wedding date.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，稍更儀注。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, the ritual regulations were slightly revised.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year the ritual regulations were slightly revised.

sentences.zh: 然儀注雖存，其拜姑舅及公主駙馬相向拜之禮，終明之世實未嘗行也。

translations.literal: Yet though the ritual regulations remained on record, the rites of bowing to parents-in-law and the mutual prostrations of imperial princess and imperial son-in-law were in fact never practiced throughout the Ming.
translations.idiomatic: Yet although the ritual regulations remained on the books, the rites of bowing to parents-in-law and the mutual prostrations of imperial princess and imperial son-in-law were in fact never performed throughout the Ming.

sentences.zh: 明年，又更定公主、郡主封號、婚禮，及駙馬、儀賓品秩。

translations.literal: The following year, titles and wedding rites for imperial princesses and commandery princesses, as well as the ranks of imperial sons-in-law and ceremonial guests, were again fixed.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, titles and wedding rites for imperial princesses and commandery princesses, together with the ranks of imperial sons-in-law and ceremonial guests, were again fixed.

sentences.zh: 弘治二年，冊封仁和長公主，重定婚儀。

translations.literal: In the second year of Hongzhi, when Princess Renhe the Eldest was invested, the wedding rites were newly fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Hongzhi, when Princess Renhe the Eldest was invested, the wedding rites were newly established.

sentences.zh: 入府，公主駙馬同拜天地，行八拜禮。

translations.literal: Upon entering the residence, the imperial princess and imperial son-in-law together bowed to Heaven and Earth, performing eight prostrations.
translations.idiomatic: Upon entering the residence, the imperial princess and imperial son-in-law together bowed to Heaven and Earth, performing eight prostrations.

sentences.zh: 堂內設公主座於東，西向，駙馬東向座，餘如前儀。

translations.literal: Within the hall the imperial princess's seat was set on the east, facing west; the imperial son-in-law's seat faced east; the rest was as in the previous rites.
translations.idiomatic: Within the hall the imperial princess's seat was placed on the east, facing west, and the imperial son-in-law's seat faced east; the rest followed the earlier rites.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖二年，工科給事中安磐等言：「駙馬見公主，行四拜禮，公主坐受二拜。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jiajing, An Pan of the Secretariat of Works, Supervising Secretary, and others said: "When the imperial son-in-law meets the imperial princess, he performs the four-prostration rite; the imperial princess sits and receives two prostrations."
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jiajing, An Pan of the Secretariat of Works, Supervising Secretary, and others said: "When the imperial son-in-law meets the imperial princess, he performs the four-prostration rite, and the imperial princess sits and receives two prostrations."

sentences.zh: 雖貴賤本殊，而夫婦分定，於禮不安。

translations.literal: Though noble and humble are fundamentally different, the husband-wife relationship is fixed; in ritual this is uneasy.
translations.idiomatic: Though noble and humble are fundamentally different, the roles of husband and wife are fixed, and in ritual this is improper.

sentences.zh: 」不聽。

translations.literal: " The emperor did not heed this.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor did not accept this.

sentences.zh: 崇禎元年，教習駙馬主事陳鍾盛言：「臣都習駙馬鞏永固，駙馬黎明於府門外月臺四拜，云至三月後，則上堂、上門、上影壁，行禮如前。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongzhen, Chen Zhongsheng, supervising director of instruction for imperial sons-in-law, said: "Your subject instructed the imperial son-in-law Gong Yonggu. At dawn the imperial son-in-law performed four prostrations on the moon terrace outside the residence gate; it was said that after three months he would go up to the hall, the gate, and the spirit screen wall, performing rites as before."
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Chongzhen, Chen Zhongsheng, supervising director of instruction for imperial sons-in-law, said: "Your subject instructed the imperial son-in-law Gong Yonggu. At dawn the imperial son-in-law made four prostrations on the moon terrace outside the residence gate; it was said that after three months he would ascend to the hall, the gate, and the spirit screen wall and perform the same rites as before."

sentences.zh: 始視膳於公主前，公主飲食於上，駙馬侍立於旁，過此，方議成婚。

translations.literal: Only then would he attend meals before the imperial princess; the imperial princess dined above while the imperial son-in-law stood in attendance beside her; only after this would marriage be discussed.
translations.idiomatic: Only then would he attend meals in the imperial princess's presence; the imperial princess ate above while the imperial son-in-law stood in attendance at her side, and only after this was marriage to be discussed.

sentences.zh: 駙馬饋果餚書臣，公主答禮書賜，皆大失禮。

translations.literal: The imperial son-in-law presented fruit and delicacies addressing himself as "your subject"; the imperial princess replied with a gift letter of courtesy— all greatly contrary to ritual.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial son-in-law presented fruit and delicacies in a letter addressing himself as "your subject," and the imperial princess replied with a courtesy gift letter— all of this was grossly contrary to ritual.

sentences.zh: 夫既合巹，則儼然夫婦，安有跪拜數月，稱臣侍膳，然後成婚者？

translations.literal: Once the nuptial cups are joined, they are manifestly husband and wife— how can there be months of prostrations, calling oneself "subject" and attending meals, and only then marrying?
translations.idiomatic: Once the nuptial cups are joined, they are plainly husband and wife— how can there be months of prostrations, calling oneself "subject" and attending meals, and only then marrying?

sentences.zh: 《會典》行四拜於合巹之前，明合巹後無拜禮也。

translations.literal: The Institute Regulations prescribe four prostrations before joining the nuptial cups; clearly after joining the nuptial cups there are no prostration rites.
translations.idiomatic: The Institute Regulations prescribe four prostrations before the joining of the nuptial cups; clearly after the nuptial cups are joined there are no prostration rites.

sentences.zh: 以天子館甥，下同隸役，豈所以尊朝廷？

translations.literal: As the Son of Heaven lodges his son-in-law, yet he is ranked with common servitors— is this how to honor the court?
translations.idiomatic: When the Son of Heaven lodges his son-in-law, yet treats him like a common servitor— is this how the court is to be honored?

sentences.zh: 」帝是其言，令永固即擇日成婚。

translations.literal: " The emperor approved his words and ordered Yonggu to choose a day immediately to marry.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor approved his argument and ordered Yonggu to choose a day at once and marry.

sentences.zh: 凡選駙馬，禮部榜諭在京官員軍民子弟年十四至十六，容貌齊整、行止端莊、有家教者報名，司禮內臣於諸王館會選。

translations.literal: Generally, in selecting an imperial son-in-law, the Ministry of Rites posted notices summoning sons of officials, soldiers, and commoners in the capital aged fourteen to sixteen who were well favored in appearance, dignified in deportment, and well brought up to register; eunuchs of the Directorate of Ceremonial conducted the selection at the Princes' Lodge.
translations.idiomatic: Generally, in selecting an imperial son-in-law, the Ministry of Rites posted notices calling sons of officials, soldiers, and commoners in the capital aged fourteen to sixteen who were handsome, dignified in deportment, and well brought up to register; eunuchs of the Directorate of Ceremonial conducted the selection at the Princes' Lodge.

sentences.zh: 不中，則博訪於畿內、山東、河南。

translations.literal: If none qualified, they searched broadly within the capital region, Shandong, and Henan.
translations.idiomatic: If none qualified, they searched broadly in the capital region, Shandong, and Henan.

sentences.zh: 選中三人，欽定一人，餘二人送本處儒學，充廩生。

translations.literal: Three were selected; one was chosen by imperial decision; the other two were sent to local Confucian schools in their home places to serve as stipend students.
translations.idiomatic: Three were selected; one was chosen by imperial decision, and the other two were sent to local Confucian schools in their home districts to serve as stipend students.

sentences.zh: 自宣德時，駙馬始有教習，用學官爲之。

translations.literal: From the Xuande era, imperial sons-in-law first had instructors, using academic officials for this.
translations.idiomatic: From the Xuande era, imperial sons-in-law first received instructors, drawn from academic officials.

sentences.zh: 正統以後，令駙馬赴監讀書習禮。

translations.literal: After the Zhengtong era, imperial sons-in-law were ordered to attend the Directorate of Education to study and learn ritual.
translations.idiomatic: After the Zhengtong era, imperial sons-in-law were ordered to attend the Directorate of Education to study and learn ritual.

sentences.zh: 嘉請六年，始定禮部主事一人，專在駙馬府教習。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Jiajing, one supervising secretary of the Ministry of Rites was first fixed to instruct exclusively at the imperial son-in-law's residence.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Jiajing, one supervising secretary of the Ministry of Rites was first appointed to instruct exclusively at the imperial son-in-law's residence.

sentences.zh: 品官婚禮

translations.literal: Wedding Rites for Officials of Rank
translations.idiomatic: Wedding Rites for Ranked Officials

sentences.zh: 周制，凡公侯大夫士之婚娶者，用六禮。

translations.literal: Under Zhou institutions, all who married among dukes, marquises, grand masters, and servitors used the Six Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Under Zhou institutions, all marriages among dukes, marquises, grand masters, and servitors followed the Six Rites.

sentences.zh: 唐以後，儀物多以官品爲降殺。

translations.literal: After the Tang, ceremonial objects were mostly scaled down according to official rank.
translations.idiomatic: After the Tang, ceremonial objects were mostly scaled down according to official rank.

sentences.zh: 明洪武五年詔曰：「古之婚禮，結兩姓之歡，以重人倫。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Hongwu the Ming edict said: "The marriage rites of antiquity joined the joy of two surnames to weight human relations."
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Hongwu an edict said: "The marriage rites of antiquity joined two families in mutual joy to uphold human relations."

sentences.zh: 近世以來，專論聘財，習染奢侈。

translations.literal: In recent generations people have fixated on betrothal wealth and grown accustomed to extravagance.
translations.idiomatic: In recent times people have fixated on betrothal wealth and grown accustomed to extravagance.

sentences.zh: 其儀制頒行。

translations.literal: Its ritual regulations were promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: Its ritual regulations were promulgated.

sentences.zh: 務從節儉，以厚風俗。

translations.literal: Practice thrift to enrich custom.
translations.idiomatic: Practice thrift to strengthen custom.

sentences.zh: 」故其時品節詳明，皆有限制，後克遵者鮮矣。

translations.literal: " Thus at that time grades and observances were detailed and clear, all with limits; afterward few were able to observe them.
translations.idiomatic: " Thus at that time grades and observances were detailed and clear, all with fixed limits; afterward few were able to observe them.

sentences.zh: 其制，凡品官婚娶，或爲子聘婦，皆使媒氏通書。

translations.literal: The regulations: generally when ranked officials married, or betrothed wives for their sons, a matchmaker was sent to exchange letters.
translations.idiomatic: The regulations held that whenever ranked officials married, or betrothed wives for their sons, a matchmaker was sent to exchange letters.

sentences.zh: 女氏許之，擇吉納采。

translations.literal: When the bride's family assented, an auspicious day was chosen for betrothal gifts.
translations.idiomatic: When the bride's family assented, an auspicious day was chosen for the betrothal gift rite.

sentences.zh: 主婚者設賓席。

translations.literal: The presiding host set out seats for the envoy.
translations.idiomatic: The presiding host set out seats for the envoy.

sentences.zh: 至日，具祝版告廟訖，賓至女氏第。

translations.literal: On the day, when prayer boards were prepared and the ancestral temple notified, the envoy arrived at the bride's family's residence.
translations.idiomatic: On the appointed day, once prayer boards had been prepared and the ancestral temple notified, the envoy arrived at the bride's family's residence.

sentences.zh: 主婚者公服出迎，揖賓及媒氏人。

translations.literal: The presiding host in official dress went out to welcome, bowing to the envoy and matchmaker.
translations.idiomatic: The presiding host in official dress went out to welcome them, bowing to the envoy and the matchmaker.

sentences.zh: 雁及禮物陳於廳。

translations.literal: Wild geese and gifts were displayed in the hall.
translations.idiomatic: Wild geese and ceremonial gifts were laid out in the hall.

sentences.zh: 賓左主右，媒氏立於賓南，皆再拜。

translations.literal: Envoy on the left, host on the right; matchmaker stood south of the envoy; all performed two prostrations.
translations.idiomatic: The envoy stood on the left, the host on the right; the matchmaker stood south of the envoy, and all made two prostrations.

sentences.zh: 賓詣主人曰：「某官以伉儷之重施於某，某率循典禮，謹使某納采。

translations.literal: The envoy addressed the host: "Official So-and-so, with the weight of marriage alliance, bestows this upon So-and-so; I, following ritual precedent, respectfully send So-and-so to present betrothal gifts."
translations.idiomatic: The envoy addressed the host: "Official So-and-so, with the weight of marriage alliance, bestows this upon So-and-so; I, following ritual precedent, respectfully send So-and-so to present betrothal gifts."

sentences.zh: 」主婚者曰：「某之子弗嫺姆訓，既辱採擇，敢不拜嘉。

translations.literal: " The presiding host said: "So-and-so's son is not skilled in matron's instruction; having suffered your selection, how dare I not accept with gratitude."
translations.idiomatic: " The presiding host said: "So-and-so's son is not well trained in a matron's instruction; having honored us with your selection, how dare I not accept with gratitude."

sentences.zh: 」賓主西東相向坐，徹雁受禮訖，復陳雁及問名禮物。

translations.literal: " Host and envoy sat facing each other west and east; when wild geese were removed and gifts received, wild geese and name-inquiry gifts were displayed again.
translations.idiomatic: " Host and envoy sat facing each other, west and east; when the wild geese had been removed and the gifts received, wild geese and name-inquiry gifts were displayed again.

sentences.zh: 賓興，詣主婚者曰：「某官慎重婚禮，將加卜筮，請問名。

translations.literal: The envoy rose and addressed the presiding host: "Official So-and-so weighs the marriage rite heavily and will consult divination; I request to inquire the name."
translations.idiomatic: The envoy rose and addressed the presiding host: "Official So-and-so weighs the marriage rite heavily and will consult divination; I request to inquire the name."

sentences.zh: 」主婚者進曰：「某第幾女，妻某氏出。

translations.literal: " The presiding host stepped forward: "So-and-so's such-and-such-numbered daughter, born of Lady So-and-so."
translations.idiomatic: " The presiding host stepped forward: "So-and-so's such-and-such-numbered daughter, born of Lady So-and-so."

sentences.zh: 」或以紅羅，或以銷金紙，書女之第行年歲。

translations.literal: " On red silk or gilt paper was written the daughter's birth order and age.
translations.idiomatic: " On red silk or gilt paper was written the daughter's birth order and age.

sentences.zh: 賓辭，主婚者請禮從者。

translations.literal: The envoy took leave; the presiding host invited those who had brought gifts.
translations.idiomatic: The envoy took leave, and the presiding host invited the gift-bearing attendants.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，送賓至門外。

translations.literal: When the rite was complete, the envoy was escorted to outside the gate.
translations.idiomatic: When the rite was finished, the envoy was escorted to the gate.

sentences.zh: 納吉如納采儀。

translations.literal: Auspicious confirmation followed the betrothal gift rite.
translations.idiomatic: The auspicious-confirmation rite followed the betrothal gift rite.

sentences.zh: 賓致詞曰：「某官承嘉命，稽諸卜筮，龜筮協從，使某告吉。

translations.literal: The envoy addressed: "Official So-and-so, receiving your gracious command, having examined divination— tortoise and milfoil in concord— sends me to announce auspiciousness."
translations.idiomatic: The envoy addressed: "Official So-and-so, receiving your gracious command and having examined divination— tortoise and milfoil in concord— sends me to announce auspiciousness."

sentences.zh: 」主婚者曰：「某未教之女，既以吉告，其何敢辭。

translations.literal: " The presiding host said: "So-and-so's untaught daughter— now that auspiciousness is announced, how could I decline."
translations.idiomatic: " The presiding host said: "So-and-so's untaught daughter— now that auspiciousness has been announced, how could I decline."

sentences.zh: 」納徵如納吉儀，加玄纁束帛、函書，不用雁。

translations.literal: " Betrothal gifts followed the auspicious-confirmation rite, adding dark-red and light-red silk bundles and letter cases, without wild geese.
translations.idiomatic: " The betrothal gift rite followed the auspicious-confirmation rite, adding dark-red and light-red silk bundles and letter cases, without wild geese.

sentences.zh: 賓致詞曰：「某官以伉儷之重，加惠某官，率循典禮。

translations.literal: The envoy addressed: "Official So-and-so, with the weight of marriage alliance, adds grace to Official So-and-so, following ritual precedent."
translations.idiomatic: The envoy addressed: "Official So-and-so, with the weight of marriage alliance, adds grace to Official So-and-so, following ritual precedent."

sentences.zh: 有不腆之幣，敢請納徵。

translations.literal: I have unworthy gifts and respectfully request to present betrothal gifts.
translations.idiomatic: I have unworthy gifts and respectfully request to present betrothal gifts.

sentences.zh: 」主婚者曰：「某官貺某以重禮，某敢不拜受。

translations.literal: " The presiding host said: "Official So-and-so bestows heavy gifts upon me; how dare I not accept with a bow."
translations.idiomatic: " The presiding host said: "Official So-and-so bestows heavy gifts upon me; how dare I not accept them with a bow."

sentences.zh: 」賓以函書授主婚者，主婚者亦答以函書。

translations.literal: " The envoy handed the letter case to the presiding host; the presiding host also replied with a letter case.
translations.idiomatic: " The envoy handed the letter case to the presiding host, and the presiding host also replied with a letter case.

sentences.zh: 請期，亦如納吉儀。

translations.literal: Requesting the date likewise followed the auspicious-confirmation rite.
translations.idiomatic: Requesting the wedding date likewise followed the auspicious-confirmation rite.

sentences.zh: 親迎日，婿父告於禰廟。

translations.literal: On the day of personal welcome, the groom's father announced at the shrine of the recent ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: On the day of the personal welcome, the groom's father announced at the shrine of the recent ancestor.

sentences.zh: 婿北面再拜立，父命之曰：「躬迎嘉偶，釐爾內治。

translations.literal: The groom, facing north, performed two prostrations and stood; the father charged him: "Go in person to welcome your excellent mate; put your inner household in order."
translations.idiomatic: The groom, facing north, made two prostrations and stood; his father charged him: "Go in person to welcome your excellent mate; put your inner household in order."

sentences.zh: 」婿進曰：「敢不承命。

translations.literal: " The groom stepped forward: "How dare I not accept the charge."
translations.idiomatic: " The groom stepped forward: "How dare I not accept the charge."

sentences.zh: 」再拜，媒氏導婿之女家。

translations.literal: " Two prostrations; the matchmaker guided the groom to the bride's home.
translations.idiomatic: " He made two prostrations, and the matchmaker guided the groom to the bride's home.

sentences.zh: 其日，女氏主婚者告廟訖，醴女如家人禮。

translations.literal: That day, the bride's family's presiding host finished announcing at the temple and performed the cordial to the bride as in family rites.
translations.idiomatic: That day, the bride's family's presiding host finished announcing at the temple and performed the cordial to the bride according to family rites.

sentences.zh: 婿至門，下馬，就大門外之次。

translations.literal: When the groom reached the gate, he dismounted and went to the pavilion outside the main gate.
translations.idiomatic: When the groom reached the gate, he dismounted and went to the pavilion outside the main gate.

sentences.zh: 女從者請女盛服，就寢門內，南向坐。

translations.literal: The bride's attendants requested the bride dress splendidly and sit facing south inside the bridal chamber door.
translations.idiomatic: The bride's attendants had the bride dress splendidly and sit facing south inside the bridal chamber door.

sentences.zh: 婿出次，主婚者出迎於門外，揖而入。

translations.literal: The groom came out of the pavilion; the presiding host went out to welcome at the gate and bowed him in.
translations.idiomatic: The groom came out of the pavilion; the presiding host went out to welcome him at the gate and bowed him in.

sentences.zh: 主婚者入門而右。

translations.literal: The presiding host entered the gate and turned right.
translations.idiomatic: The presiding host entered the gate and turned right.

sentences.zh: 婿入門而左，執雁者從，至寢戶前，北面立。

translations.literal: The groom entered the gate and turned left; the goose bearer followed, proceeding to before the bridal chamber door and standing facing north.
translations.idiomatic: The groom entered the gate and turned left, the goose bearer following behind; they proceeded to the bridal chamber door, where he stood facing north.

sentences.zh: 主婚者立於戶東，西向。

translations.literal: The presiding host stood east of the door, facing west.
translations.idiomatic: The presiding host stood to the east of the door, facing west.

sentences.zh: 婿再拜，奠雁，出就次。

translations.literal: The groom bowed twice, placed the wild geese, went out and took his place in the pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: The groom bowed twice, presented the wild geese, then withdrew to the pavilion.

sentences.zh: 主婚者不降送。

translations.literal: The presiding host did not descend to see him off.
translations.idiomatic: The presiding host did not come down to escort him out.

sentences.zh: 婿既出，女父母南向坐，保母導女四拜。

translations.literal: Once the groom had gone out, the bride's parents sat facing south; the nursemaid guided the bride in four bows.
translations.idiomatic: After the groom had departed, the bride's parents seated themselves facing south, and the nursemaid guided the bride in four bows.

sentences.zh: 父命之曰：「往之女家，以順爲正，無忘肅恭。

translations.literal: The father admonished her: "When you go to your husband's home, take obedience as your standard; do not forget reverence and respect.
translations.idiomatic: The father admonished her: "When you go to your husband's home, let obedience be your guiding principle; never forget reverence and decorum.

sentences.zh: 」母命之曰：「必恭必戒，毋違舅姑之命。

translations.literal: " The mother admonished her: "Be ever reverent and ever cautious; do not disobey your parents-in-law's commands.
translations.idiomatic: " The mother admonished her: "Be ever reverent and ever watchful; do not defy the commands of your husband's parents.

sentences.zh: 」庶母申之曰：「爾忱聽於訓言，毋作父母羞。

translations.literal: " The concubine mother added: "Listen earnestly to these words of instruction; do not bring shame upon your parents.
translations.idiomatic: " The concubine mother added: "Heed these words of instruction with all your heart; do not bring shame upon your parents.

sentences.zh: 」保姆及侍女翼女出門，升車。

translations.literal: " The nursemaid and serving maids flanked the bride as she went out the gate and mounted the carriage.
translations.idiomatic: " The nursemaid and serving maids flanked the bride as she passed through the gate and mounted the carriage.

sentences.zh: 儀衛導前，送者乘車後。

translations.literal: Ceremonial guards led the way; those seeing her off followed in carriages behind.
translations.idiomatic: Ceremonial guards led the procession; those seeing her off followed in carriages behind.

sentences.zh: 婿先還以俟。

translations.literal: The groom returned first to await her.
translations.idiomatic: The groom returned home first to await her arrival.

sentences.zh: 婦車至門，出迎於門內，揖婦入。

translations.literal: When the bride's carriage reached the gate, he went out to welcome her inside the gate and bowed her in.
translations.idiomatic: When the bride's carriage reached the gate, the groom went out to welcome her within the gate and bowed her inside.

sentences.zh: 及寢門，婿先升階，婦從升。

translations.literal: At the bridal chamber door, the groom ascended the steps first; the bride followed and ascended.
translations.idiomatic: At the bridal chamber door, the groom ascended the steps first, and the bride followed.

sentences.zh: 入室，婿盥於室之東南，婦從者執巾進水以沃之；

translations.literal: Entering the chamber, the groom washed at the southeast of the room; the bride's attendants held towels and brought water to pour over his hands;
translations.idiomatic: Entering the chamber, the groom washed his hands at the southeast corner of the room, while the bride's attendants held towels and brought water to pour over them;

sentences.zh: 婦盥於室之西北，婿從者執巾進水以沃之。

translations.literal: the bride washed at the northwest of the room; the groom's attendants held towels and brought water to pour over her hands.
translations.idiomatic: the bride washed at the northwest corner, while the groom's attendants held towels and brought water to pour over her hands.

sentences.zh: 盥畢，各就坐，婿東，婦西。

translations.literal: When the washing was finished, each took his seat—the groom to the east, the bride to the west.
translations.idiomatic: When the washing was complete, each took a seat: the groom to the east, the bride to the west.

sentences.zh: 舉食案，進酒，進饌。

translations.literal: Food trays were raised; wine was presented, then dishes.
translations.idiomatic: Food trays were brought forward; wine was served, then the dishes.

sentences.zh: 酒食訖，復進如初。

translations.literal: When the wine and food were finished, they were presented again as at first.
translations.idiomatic: When the wine and food were finished, a second round was served as before.

sentences.zh: 侍女以巹注酒，進於婿婦前。

translations.literal: Serving maids poured wine into the nuptial cup and presented it before the groom and bride.
translations.idiomatic: Serving maids filled the nuptial cup with wine and presented it before the groom and bride.

sentences.zh: 各飲畢，皆興，立於座南，東西相向，皆再拜。

translations.literal: When each had finished drinking, all rose, stood south of their seats facing east and west, and all bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: When each had finished drinking, they all rose and stood south of their seats, facing each other east and west, and bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 婿婦入室，易服。

translations.literal: The groom and bride entered the chamber and changed clothes.
translations.idiomatic: The groom and bride entered the chamber and changed their garments.

sentences.zh: 婿從者餕婦之餘，婦從者餕婿之餘。

translations.literal: The groom's attendants ate the bride's leftovers; the bride's attendants ate the groom's leftovers.
translations.idiomatic: The groom's attendants ate what the bride had left; the bride's attendants ate what the groom had left.

sentences.zh: 明日見宗廟，設婿父拜位於東階下，婿於其後；

translations.literal: The next day they visited the ancestral temple; the groom's father's bowing place was set below the eastern steps, with the groom behind him;
translations.idiomatic: The next day they paid respects at the ancestral temple; the groom's father's bowing position was set below the eastern steps, with the groom standing behind him;

sentences.zh: 主婦拜位於西階下，婦於其後。

translations.literal: the chief hostess's bowing place was below the western steps, with the bride behind her.
translations.idiomatic: the chief hostess's bowing position was below the western steps, with the bride standing behind her.

sentences.zh: 諸親各以序分立。

translations.literal: All relatives stood in separate ranks according to order.
translations.idiomatic: All relatives took their places in order of precedence.

sentences.zh: 其日夙興，婿父以下各就位，再拜。

translations.literal: On that day they rose early; from the groom's father downward each took his place and bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: On that day they rose at dawn; from the groom's father downward, each took his place and bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 贊禮引婦至庭中，北面立。

translations.literal: The ritual announcer led the bride to the courtyard and she stood facing north.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual announcer led the bride into the courtyard, where she stood facing north.

sentences.zh: 婿父升自東階，詣神位前，跪。

translations.literal: The groom's father ascended by the eastern steps, went before the spirit tablet, and knelt.
translations.idiomatic: The groom's father ascended the eastern steps, proceeded before the spirit tablet, and knelt.

sentences.zh: 三上香，三祭酒，讀祝，興，立於西。

translations.literal: He offered incense three times, poured libation three times, read the prayer, rose, and stood to the west.
translations.idiomatic: He offered incense three times and poured libation three times, read the prayer, then rose and stood to the west.

sentences.zh: 婦四拜，退，復位。

translations.literal: The bride performed four bows, withdrew, and returned to her place.
translations.idiomatic: The bride performed four bows, withdrew, and returned to her position.

sentences.zh: 婿父降自西階就拜位，婿父以下皆再拜，禮畢。

translations.literal: The groom's father descended by the western steps to his bowing place; from the groom's father downward all bowed twice, and the rite was complete.
translations.idiomatic: The groom's father descended the western steps to his bowing position; from the groom's father downward, all bowed twice, and the rite was finished.

sentences.zh: 次見舅姑。

translations.literal: Next they paid respects to the parents-in-law.
translations.idiomatic: Next came the presentation to the parents-in-law.

sentences.zh: 其日，婦立堂下，伺舅姑即座，就位四拜。

translations.literal: On that day the bride stood below the hall, waited until the parents-in-law took their seats, then took her place and performed four bows.
translations.idiomatic: On that day the bride stood below the hall, waiting until her parents-in-law were seated; then she took her place and performed four bows.

sentences.zh: 保姆引婦升自西階，至舅前，侍女奉棗慄授婦。

translations.literal: The nursemaid led the bride up the western steps to before the father-in-law; serving maids presented dates and chestnuts and handed them to the bride.
translations.idiomatic: The nursemaid led the bride up the western steps to before her father-in-law, where serving maids presented dates and chestnuts for her to offer.

sentences.zh: 婦進訖，降階四拜。

translations.literal: When the bride had finished presenting, she descended the steps and performed four bows.
translations.idiomatic: When the bride had finished presenting the gifts, she descended the steps and performed four bows.

sentences.zh: 詣姑前，進腶修，如前儀。

translations.literal: She went before the mother-in-law and presented dried meat, following the same rite as before.
translations.idiomatic: She proceeded before her mother-in-law and presented dried meat, following the same procedure as before.

sentences.zh: 次舅姑醴婦，如家人禮。

translations.literal: Next the parents-in-law presented ceremonial wine to the bride, as in the rites of the household.
translations.idiomatic: Next the parents-in-law presented ceremonial wine to the bride, following the rites observed within the family.

sentences.zh: 次盥饋。

translations.literal: Next came hand-washing and serving food.
translations.idiomatic: Next came the rite of hand-washing and serving food.

sentences.zh: 其日，婦家備饌至婿家。

translations.literal: On that day the bride's family prepared dishes and brought them to the groom's home.
translations.idiomatic: On that day the bride's family prepared a feast and sent it to the groom's home.

sentences.zh: 舅姑即座，婦四拜。

translations.literal: When the parents-in-law took their seats, the bride performed four bows.
translations.idiomatic: When the parents-in-law were seated, the bride performed four bows.

sentences.zh: 升自西階，至舅前。

translations.literal: She ascended by the western steps to before the father-in-law.
translations.idiomatic: She ascended the western steps to before her father-in-law.

sentences.zh: 從者舉食案以饌授婦，婦進饌，執事者加匕箸。

translations.literal: Attendants raised food trays and handed dishes to the bride; the bride presented the dishes, and officiants added spoons and chopsticks.
translations.idiomatic: Attendants raised food trays and handed the dishes to the bride; she presented them, and the officiants added spoons and chopsticks.

sentences.zh: 進饌於姑，亦如之。

translations.literal: Presenting dishes to the mother-in-law followed the same procedure.
translations.idiomatic: She presented dishes to her mother-in-law in the same manner.

sentences.zh: 食訖，徹饌，婦降階就位，四拜，禮畢。

translations.literal: When the meal was finished, the dishes were cleared; the bride descended the steps, took her place, performed four bows, and the rite was complete.
translations.idiomatic: When the meal was finished and the dishes cleared, the bride descended the steps, took her place, performed four bows, and the rite was complete.

sentences.zh: 舅姑再醴婦，如初儀。

translations.literal: The parents-in-law again presented ceremonial wine to the bride, as in the first rite.
translations.idiomatic: The parents-in-law again presented ceremonial wine to the bride, following the initial ceremony.

sentences.zh: 庶人婚禮

translations.literal: Wedding Rites for Commoners
translations.idiomatic: Wedding Rites for Commoners

sentences.zh: 皇帝視學儀

translations.literal: Rites for the Emperor's Inspection of the Imperial Academy
translations.idiomatic: Rites for the Emperor's Inspection of the Imperial Academy

sentences.zh: 《禮》曰：「凡始立學者，必釋奠於先聖先師。

translations.literal: The Rites says: "Whenever one first establishes a school, one must perform a libation sacrifice to the previous sage and previous teacher.
translations.idiomatic: The Rites states: "Whenever a school is first established, a libation sacrifice must be performed to the previous sage and previous teacher.

sentences.zh: 」週末淪喪，禮廢不行。

translations.literal: " By the end of the Zhou the rites were lost and no longer practiced.
translations.idiomatic: " By the end of the Zhou dynasty the rites had fallen into ruin and were no longer observed.

sentences.zh: 漢明帝始幸辟雍。

translations.literal: Emperor Ming of Han first visited the Enclosure of Refinement.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Ming of Han was the first to visit the Enclosure of Refinement.

sentences.zh: 唐以後，天子視學，始設講榻。

translations.literal: From Tang onward, when the Son of Heaven inspected the academy, a lectern was first set up.
translations.idiomatic: From the Tang dynasty onward, when the Son of Heaven inspected the academy, a lectern was first established for the occasion.

sentences.zh: 洪武十五年，太祖將幸國子監。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Hongwu, the Founding Emperor was about to visit the Imperial Academy.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year of Hongwu, the Founding Emperor was preparing to visit the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 議者言，孔子雖聖，乃人臣，禮宜一奠而再拜。

translations.literal: Those deliberating said that although Confucius was a sage, he was still a subject; the rite should be one libation and two bows.
translations.idiomatic: Counselors argued that although Confucius was a sage, he remained a subject, and the proper rite should be one libation and two bows.

sentences.zh: 太祖不從，命禮部尚書劉仲質定其制。

translations.literal: The Founding Emperor did not agree and ordered Minister of Rites Liu Zhongzhi to fix the regulations.
translations.idiomatic: The Founding Emperor would not accept this and ordered Minister of Rites Liu Zhongzhi to establish the proper regulations.

sentences.zh: 前期設御幄於大成門東，南向，設御座於彝倫堂。

translations.literal: Beforehand the imperial pavilion was set east of the Great Completion Gate, facing south; the imperial throne was set in the Hall of Human Relations.
translations.idiomatic: In advance an imperial pavilion was erected east of the Great Completion Gate, facing south, and the imperial throne was placed in the Hall of Human Relations.

sentences.zh: 至日，學官率諸生迎駕於成賢街左。

translations.literal: On the appointed day, academy officials led the students to welcome the imperial carriage on the left of the Street of Accomplished Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: On the appointed day, academy officials led the students to welcome the imperial procession on the left side of the Street of Accomplished Worthies.

sentences.zh: 皇帝入御幄，具皮弁服，詣先師神位，再拜。

translations.literal: The emperor entered the imperial pavilion, donned dark cap and ceremonial robes, went to the spirit tablet of the previous teacher, and bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor entered the imperial pavilion, put on dark cap and ceremonial robes, proceeded to the spirit tablet of the previous teacher, and bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 獻爵，復再拜。

translations.literal: He presented the libation cup and again bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: He presented the libation cup and bowed twice again.

sentences.zh: 四配、十哲、兩廡分獻，如常儀。

translations.literal: Separate offerings for the Four Correlate Sages, the Ten Wise Ones, and the two wing halls followed the usual rite.
translations.idiomatic: Separate offerings for the Four Correlate Sages, the Ten Wise Ones, and the two wing halls were made according to the usual ceremony.

sentences.zh: 皇帝入御幄，易常服。

translations.literal: The emperor entered the imperial pavilion and changed into ordinary dress.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor returned to the imperial pavilion and changed into ordinary dress.

sentences.zh: 升輿，至彝倫堂升座。

translations.literal: He mounted the carriage, proceeded to the Hall of Human Relations, and ascended the throne.
translations.idiomatic: He mounted his carriage, proceeded to the Hall of Human Relations, and took the throne.

sentences.zh: 學官諸生五拜叩頭，東西序立於堂下。

translations.literal: Academy officials and students performed five bows and kowtows, then stood below the hall in ranks east and west.
translations.idiomatic: Academy officials and students performed five bows and kowtows, then stood below the hall in ranks to the east and west.

sentences.zh: 三品以上及侍從官，以次入堂，東西序立。

translations.literal: Officials of third rank and above and attendant officials entered the hall in order and stood in ranks east and west.
translations.idiomatic: Officials of third rank and above, together with attendant officials, entered the hall in order and took their places in ranks to the east and west.

sentences.zh: 贊進講，祭酒、司業、博士、助教四人由西門入，至堂中。

translations.literal: The announcer called for the lecture to begin; the Chancellor, Vice-Chancellor, Erudite, and Assistant Instructor—four men—entered by the western gate and came to the center of the hall.
translations.idiomatic: The announcer called for the lecture to begin; the Chancellor, Vice-Chancellor, Erudite, and Assistant Instructor—the four lecturers—entered through the western gate and proceeded to the center of the hall.

sentences.zh: 贊舉經案於御前，禮部官奏，請授經於講官。

translations.literal: The announcer raised the classic lectern before the emperor; an official of the Ministry of Rites memorialized, requesting that the classic be entrusted to the lecturer.
translations.idiomatic: The announcer raised the classic lectern before the emperor; a Ministry of Rites official memorialized, requesting that the classic be entrusted to the lecturer.

sentences.zh: 祭酒跪受。

translations.literal: The Chancellor knelt and received it.
translations.idiomatic: The Chancellor knelt and received it.

sentences.zh: 賜講官坐。

translations.literal: Seats were granted to the lecturers.
translations.idiomatic: Seats were granted to the lecturers.

sentences.zh: 及以經置講案，叩頭，就西南隅几榻坐講。

translations.literal: When the classic had been placed on the lectern, he kowtowed, then took his seat on the couch at the southwest corner to lecture.
translations.idiomatic: When the classic had been placed on the lectern, he kowtowed, then took his seat on the couch in the southwest corner to deliver the lecture.

sentences.zh: 賜大臣翰林儒臣坐，皆叩頭，序坐於東西，諸生圜立以聽。

translations.literal: Seats were granted to grand ministers and Hanlin scholar-officials; all kowtowed and took their seats in order east and west, while the students stood in a circle to listen.
translations.idiomatic: Seats were granted to grand ministers and Hanlin scholar-officials; all kowtowed and took their seats in order to the east and west, while the students stood in a circle to listen.

sentences.zh: 講畢，叩頭，退就本位。

translations.literal: When the lecture was finished, he kowtowed, withdrew, and returned to his original place.
translations.idiomatic: When the lecture was finished, he kowtowed, withdrew, and returned to his original position.

sentences.zh: 司業、博士、助教，各以次進講。

translations.literal: The Vice-Chancellor, Erudite, and Assistant Instructor each lectured in turn.
translations.idiomatic: The Vice-Chancellor, Erudite, and Assistant Instructor each delivered their lectures in turn.

sentences.zh: 出堂門，復位。

translations.literal: They went out through the hall gate and returned to their places.
translations.idiomatic: They exited through the hall gate and returned to their positions.

sentences.zh: 贊宣制，學官諸生列班俱北面跪，聽宣諭，五拜叩頭。

translations.literal: The announcer proclaimed the imperial edict; academy officials and students all lined up facing north and knelt, listened to the proclamation, and performed five bows and kowtows.
translations.idiomatic: The announcer proclaimed the imperial edict; academy officials and students all formed ranks facing north and knelt, listened to the proclamation, and performed five bows and kowtows.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，學官諸生出成賢街送駕。

translations.literal: When the rite was complete, academy officials and students went out to the Street of Accomplished Worthies to see off the imperial carriage.
translations.idiomatic: When the ceremony was complete, academy officials and students went out to the Street of Accomplished Worthies to see off the imperial procession.

sentences.zh: 明日，祭酒率學官上表謝恩。

translations.literal: The next day the Chancellor led the academy officials in submitting a memorial of thanks for imperial grace.
translations.idiomatic: The next day the Chancellor led the academy officials in submitting a memorial expressing gratitude for the imperial favor.

sentences.zh: 永樂四年，禮部尚書鄭賜引宋制，請服靴袍，再拜。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yongle, Minister of Rites Zheng Ci cited Song regulations and requested boots and court robes, with two bows.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Yongle, Minister of Rites Zheng Ci cited Song dynasty precedent and requested that the emperor wear boots and court robes and perform two bows.

sentences.zh: 帝不從，仍行四拜禮。

translations.literal: The emperor did not agree and still performed the rite of four bows.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor would not accept this and continued to perform the rite of four bows.

sentences.zh: 進講畢，賜百官茶。

translations.literal: When the lectures were finished, tea was granted to all officials.
translations.idiomatic: When the lectures were finished, tea was bestowed upon all officials.

sentences.zh: 禮部請立視學之碑，帝親制文勒石。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Rites requested that a stele for the academy inspection be erected; the emperor personally composed the text and had it carved in stone.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Rites requested that a stele commemorating the academy inspection be erected; the emperor personally composed the inscription and had it carved in stone.

sentences.zh: 祭酒等表謝。

translations.literal: The Chancellor and others submitted memorials of thanks.
translations.idiomatic: The Chancellor and the others submitted memorials of thanks.

sentences.zh: 帝御奉天門，賜百官宴，仍賜祭酒、司業糹寧絲羅衣各二襲，學官三十五人各糹寧絲衣一襲，監生三千餘人各鈔五錠。

translations.literal: The emperor presided at the Gate of Reverent Heaven and granted a banquet to all officials; he also granted the Chancellor and Vice-Chancellor two suits each of ramie-silk gauze robes, thirty-five academy officials one suit each of ramie-silk robes, and more than three thousand students five ingots of paper money each.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor presided at the Gate of Reverent Heaven and granted a banquet to all officials; he also bestowed upon the Chancellor and Vice-Chancellor two suits each of ramie-silk gauze robes, upon thirty-five academy officials one suit each of ramie-silk robes, and upon more than three thousand students five ingots of paper money apiece.

sentences.zh: 正統九年，帝幸國子監，如儀。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Zhengtong, the emperor visited the Imperial Academy according to the rite.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Zhengtong, the emperor visited the Imperial Academy according to the established ceremony.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，賜公、侯、伯、駙馬、武官都督以上、文官三品以上及翰林學士至檢討、國子監祭酒至學錄宴。

translations.literal: When the rite was complete, banquets were granted to dukes, marquises, earls, imperial sons-in-law, military officials of regional commander rank and above, civil officials of third rank and above, Hanlin academicians down to proofreaders, and Imperial Academy officials from Chancellor down to Registrar.
translations.idiomatic: When the ceremony was complete, banquets were granted to dukes, marquises, earls, and imperial sons-in-law; to military officials of regional commander rank and above; to civil officials of third rank and above; to Hanlin academicians down to proofreaders; and to Imperial Academy officials from the Chancellor down to the Registrar.

sentences.zh: 先是，視學祭先師，不設牲，不奏樂。

translations.literal: Previously, when inspecting the academy and sacrificing to the previous teacher, no sacrificial animals were set out and no music was performed.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, when the emperor inspected the academy and sacrificed to the previous teacher, no sacrificial animals were offered and no music was played.

sentences.zh: 至成化元年，始用牲樂。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chenghua, sacrificial animals and music were first used.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Chenghua, sacrificial animals and music were first employed.

sentences.zh: 視學之日，樂設而不作。

translations.literal: On the day of the academy inspection, music was set up but not performed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day of the academy inspection, musical instruments were set in place but not played.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，百官慶賀，賜衣服，賜宴，皆及孔、顏、孟三氏子孫。

translations.literal: When the rite was complete, all officials offered congratulations; grants of clothing and banquets extended also to the descendants of the Kong, Yan, and Meng clans.
translations.idiomatic: When the ceremony was complete, all officials offered congratulations; grants of clothing and banquets were extended to the descendants of the Kong, Yan, and Meng clans as well.

sentences.zh: 弘治元年，定先期致齋一日，奠加幣，牲用太牢，改分獻官爲分奠官。

translations.literal: In the first year of Hongzhi, it was fixed that one day beforehand one should observe abstention; libation offerings were augmented with silks; a grand sacrificial ox was used; and separate offering officials were renamed separate libation officials.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Hongzhi, it was decreed that abstention be observed one day in advance, that libation offerings be augmented with silks, that a grand sacrificial ox be used, and that separate offering officials be renamed separate libation officials.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖元年，定衍聖公率三氏子孫，祭酒率學官諸生，上表謝恩，皆賜宴於禮部。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiajing, it was fixed that the Duke Continuator of the Sage would lead the descendants of the three clans, the Chancellor would lead academy officials and students in submitting memorials of thanks, and all would be granted banquets at the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jiajing, it was decreed that the Duke Continuator of the Sage would lead the descendants of the three clans, that the Chancellor would lead academy officials and students in submitting memorials of thanks, and that all would be granted banquets at the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 十三年，以先師祀典既正，再視學，命大臣致奠啓聖公祠。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, since the sacrificial canon for the previous teacher had been corrected, the academy was again inspected and grand ministers were ordered to perform libation at the Shrine of the Sage's Progenitor.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, since the sacrificial canon for the previous teacher had been rectified, the emperor again inspected the academy and ordered grand ministers to perform libation at the Shrine of the Sage's Progenitor.

sentences.zh: 萬曆四年，定次日行慶賀禮，頒賞如舊，免賜宴。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Wanli, it was fixed that congratulations would be performed the next day, rewards distributed as before, and the granting of banquets omitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Wanli, it was decreed that congratulations would be offered the following day, rewards distributed as before, but banquets no longer granted.

sentences.zh: 初，憲宗取三氏子孫赴京觀禮，又命衍聖公分獻。

translations.literal: At first, the Chenghua Emperor summoned descendants of the three clans to the capital to observe the rites, and also ordered the Duke Continuator of the Sage to make separate offerings.
translations.idiomatic: Initially, the Chenghua Emperor summoned descendants of the three clans to the capital to observe the ceremony, and also ordered the Duke Continuator of the Sage to make separate offerings.

sentences.zh: 至世宗，命衍聖公及顏、孟二博士，孔氏老成者五人，顏、孟各二人，赴京陪祀。

translations.literal: Under the Jiajing Emperor, the Duke Continuator of the Sage and the two Erudites of the Yan and Meng clans were ordered to come to the capital to assist in the sacrifice, together with five mature members of the Kong clan and two each from the Yan and Meng clans.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Jiajing Emperor, the Duke Continuator of the Sage and the two Erudites of the Yan and Meng clans were ordered to the capital to assist in the sacrifice, together with five senior members of the Kong clan and two each from the Yan and Meng clans.

sentences.zh: 明初無定日，亦無定所。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Ming there was no fixed day and no fixed place.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Ming there was neither a fixed day nor a fixed venue.

sentences.zh: 正統初，始著爲常儀，以月之二日御文華殿進講，月三次，寒暑暫免。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Zhengtong it was first established as a regular rite: on the second day of each month the emperor would preside at the Hall of Literary Glory for lectures, three times a month, with temporary exemption in extreme cold and heat.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Zhengtong reign it was first established as a regular ceremony: on the second day of each month the emperor would preside at the Hall of Literary Glory for lectures, three times monthly, with temporary suspension during extreme cold and heat.

sentences.zh: 其制，勳臣一人知經筵事，內閣學士或知或同知。

translations.literal: The regulations: one meritorious minister oversaw Classics Lectern affairs; Grand Secretaries might oversee or jointly oversee.
translations.idiomatic: Under these regulations, one meritorious minister oversaw Classics Lectern affairs, while Grand Secretaries might serve as overseers or associate overseers.

sentences.zh: 尚書、都御史、通政使、大理卿及學士等侍班，翰林院、春坊官及國子監祭酒二員進講，春坊官二員展書，給事中御史各二員侍儀，鴻臚寺、錦衣衛堂上官各一員供事，鳴讚一讚禮，序班四舉案，勳臣或駙馬一人領將軍侍衛。

translations.literal: Ministers, Censor-in-Chief, Commissioner of the Transmission Office, President of the Court of Judicial Review, and academicians attended in attendance roster; Hanlin Academy and Eastern Palace officials and two Imperial Academy Chancellors lectured; two Eastern Palace officials unfolded the books; two supervising secretaries and two censors each attended the ceremony; one senior official each from the Court of State Ceremonial and the Embroidered Uniform Guard served; one ceremonial announcer announced the rites; four ushers raised the lecterns; one meritorious minister or imperial son-in-law led the guard attendants.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers, the Censor-in-Chief, the Commissioner of the Transmission Office, the President of the Court of Judicial Review, and academicians attended in the attendance roster; Hanlin Academy and Eastern Palace officials together with two Imperial Academy Chancellors delivered lectures; two Eastern Palace officials unfolded the books; two supervising secretaries and two censors each attended the ceremony; one senior official each from the Court of State Ceremonial and the Embroidered Uniform Guard performed service duties; one ceremonial announcer proclaimed the rites; four ushers raised the lecterns; and one meritorious minister or imperial son-in-law led the guard attendants.

sentences.zh: 禮部擇吉請，先期設御座於文華殿，設御案於座東稍南，設講案於案南稍東。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Rites chose an auspicious day and memorialized; beforehand the imperial throne was set in the Hall of Literary Glory, the imperial lectern slightly south of east from the throne, and the lecture lectern slightly east of south from the imperial lectern.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Rites chose an auspicious day and memorialized; in advance the imperial throne was placed in the Hall of Literary Glory, the imperial lectern slightly south and east of the throne, and the lecture lectern slightly east and south of the imperial lectern.

sentences.zh: 是日，司禮監先陳所講《四書》、經、史各一冊置御案，一冊置講案，皆《四書》東，經、史西。

translations.literal: On that day the Directorate of Ceremonial first displayed one volume each of the Four Books, classics, and histories to be lectured upon on the imperial lectern, and one volume on the lecture lectern; in each case the Four Books were to the east, classics and histories to the west.
translations.idiomatic: On that day the Directorate of Ceremonial first placed one volume each of the Four Books, classics, and histories to be lectured upon on the imperial lectern, and one volume on the lecture lectern; in each case the Four Books were placed to the east, the classics and histories to the west.

sentences.zh: 講官各擇撰講章置冊內。

translations.literal: Each lecturer selected and composed lecture chapters and placed them within the volumes.
translations.idiomatic: Each lecturer selected and composed lecture chapters and placed them within the bound volumes.

sentences.zh: 帝升座，知經筵及侍班等官于丹陛上，五拜三叩頭。

translations.literal: When the emperor ascended the throne, the overseer of Classics Lectern affairs and attendance-roster officials and the like on the vermillion steps performed five bows and three kowtows.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor took his seat, the overseer of Classics Lectern affairs and the officials on the attendance roster performed five bows and three kowtows on the vermillion steps.

sentences.zh: 後每講止行叩頭禮。

translations.literal: Thereafter, at each lecture only the kowtow rite was performed.
